detail.abstract: The primary objective of the chapter is to argue that a deep, symbiotic integration of these two functions is essential for building a truly effective and data-driven business strategy that fosters long-term customer loyalty. The chapter marks the amalgamation of CX and MI for a sustainable competitive advantage to move beyond their traditional treatment as separate domains. The chapter employs a conceptual framework analysis. The analysis shows that successful MI and CX integration yields significant outcomes. Case studies confirm measurable improvements in key metrics. These include customer lifetime value (LTV). Retention rates also see an enhancement. Conversion efficiency improves markedly. The findings show a need for a strategic framework. This framework must be supported by technology. A robust technological stack is crucial. The main challenge identified is not a technological problem. It is an organizational one. A cultural shift is required. This shift must break down silos. It must foster continuous learning. Marketing and CX teams must collaborate. This collaboration is critical. The chapter concludes that the symbiosis of Marketing Intelligence and Customer Experience is a fundamental and joint pillar of modern business operations. The chapter supplies a roadmap for harnessing this liaising, to the industry practitioner, policy makers, and students.

AI.tldr: 本章论证营销智能与客户体验的深度融合对于构建真正有效、数据驱动的商业战略至关重要，能够促进长期客户忠诚度，超越传统上两者作为独立领域的处理方式。
AI.research_question: 如何实现营销智能与客户体验的深度融合以构建数据驱动的商业战略并促进长期客户忠诚度？
AI.motivation: 传统上营销智能和客户体验被视为独立领域，这种分离限制了企业构建真正有效、数据驱动的商业战略的能力，无法实现可持续的竞争优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 营销智能与客户体验整合的概念框架分析，强调两者之间的共生关系作为现代商业运营的联合支柱。
AI.method: 概念框架分析和案例研究，通过实际案例验证整合效果。
AI.findings: 成功的营销智能与客户体验整合带来显著成果：客户生命周期价值提升、留存率增强、转化效率明显改善。主要挑战不是技术问题而是组织问题，需要文化转变打破部门壁垒，促进营销与客户体验团队的协作。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了营销智能与客户体验共生整合的理论框架，将两者从传统独立领域提升为现代商业运营的联合支柱，为相关研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为行业从业者、政策制定者和学生提供了实施路线图，强调需要技术支持的战略框架，以及打破部门壁垒、促进持续学习的组织文化转变。

title: Social Media Comments
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Marketing and The University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign

detail.title: Social Media Comments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research was approved by the Institutional Review Boards at Columbia University (AAAU8166).
declarations.funderStatement: The authors acknowledge financial support from the Russell Sage Foundation (Grant G-2309-44994), the Digital Future Initiative and the Bernstein Center at Columbia Business School, and the Provost Office at Columbia University.

detail.abstract: Comments are a central feature of social media platforms, enabling horizontal communication among diverse users. This paper studies how the presence and stance of comments on social media posts affect subsequent on-platform engagement and off-platform attitudes and behavior on socially important issues. For identification, we develop a novel experimental pipeline that manipulates and randomizes comment visibility and stance using Meta's built-in A/B testing infrastructure. In collaboration with a leading racial justice organization, we conduct a large scale field experiment on Facebook reaching a million U.S. users randomly assigned to one of four conditions: (i) no visible comments (control), (ii) opposing, (iii) supportive, and (iv) mixed comments displaying both stances. We find that the presence of a comment section increases engagement with the post. Importantly, comment stance matters: opposing comments significantly amplify reactions, comments, and link clicks relative to the control, whereas supportive comments have little effect. In a complementary artefactual field experiment, we find that comments increase the time spent viewing the post, and exposure to opposing comments leads to more negative perceptions of the organization, less progressive attitudes, and reduced donations. Our results reveal a fundamental trade-off between on platform engagement and off-platform attitudes and behavior, underscoring the importance of platform regulation and governance.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过Facebook大规模实验发现，社交媒体评论的存在和立场对用户参与度和态度行为有显著影响：评论区能增加帖子互动，反对性评论尤其能提升平台参与度，但同时会降低用户对组织的正面认知、进步态度和捐款意愿，揭示了平台参与度与线下态度行为之间的权衡。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体评论的存在和立场如何影响后续的平台参与度以及线下态度和行为？
AI.motivation: 评论是社交媒体的核心功能，促进用户间横向交流，但评论对用户参与度和态度行为的具体影响机制尚不明确，特别是在社会重要议题上。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社交媒体评论理论、用户参与度理论、态度行为改变理论、平台治理理论
AI.method: 1. 大规模现场实验：与种族正义组织合作，在Facebook上对百万美国用户进行随机分组实验（四种条件：无评论、反对评论、支持评论、混合评论）；2. 补充性人工现场实验：测量评论对浏览时间、组织认知、态度和捐款的影响
AI.findings: 1. 评论区存在能增加帖子互动；2. 评论立场很重要：反对评论显著放大反应、评论和链接点击，而支持评论效果有限；3. 反对评论导致对组织更负面认知、更少进步态度和更低捐款意愿；4. 平台参与度与线下态度行为存在根本性权衡
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了社交媒体评论对用户参与度和态度行为的双重影响机制；2. 提出了平台参与度与线下态度行为之间的权衡理论框架；3. 为社交媒体评论效应提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为社交媒体平台治理提供政策建议；2. 为组织在社交媒体上的传播策略提供指导；3. 强调平台监管的重要性以平衡参与度和社会影响

title: EXECUTABLE INTELLIGENCE: The AXIOM Ontology for AI-Governed Knowledge Work in Consulting Institutions - AXIOM Architecture for eXecutable Intelligence & Operational Methodology

detail.title: EXECUTABLE INTELLIGENCE: The AXIOM Ontology for AI-Governed Knowledge Work in Consulting Institutions - AXIOM Architecture for eXecutable Intelligence & Operational Methodology

detail.abstract:
The integration of artificial intelligence into knowledge-intensive consulting institutions is failing — not because the technology is insufficient, but because the governance architecture is absent. Current AI adoption in professional services follows a tool-first logic: identify a capable AI system, deploy it against existing workflows, and manage the consequences. This paper argues that tool-first adoption is architecturally backwards.


AXIOM — Architecture for eXecutable Intelligence & Operational Methodology — is the formal ontology that provides the missing governance architecture. This paper introduces the AXIOM Five-Layer Institutional Model, the AXIOM Conversion Pipeline, the AXIOM Freshness Protocol, and the theoretical foundation of the AXIOM Rating Index (AXRI) — the first proposed standard for evaluating the governance quality of AI deployments in knowledge institutions.


The unifying claim across this paper and its companion papers in investment banking (Paper 01) and defence operations (Paper 02): across all high-stakes institutional contexts, the fundamental failure of AI integration is identical. Institutions deploy computational systems against cognitive operations without first establishing the governance architecture that determines what those systems are authorised to decide, what they are required to flag, and what must remain permanently human. AXIOM provides the first formal standard for making that determination in knowledge institutions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出AXIOM框架，认为知识密集型咨询机构AI整合失败的原因是缺乏治理架构而非技术不足。当前"工具优先"的AI采用方式是架构倒置的，需要先建立治理架构再部署AI系统。
AI.research_question: 知识密集型咨询机构中AI整合失败的根本原因是什么？如何建立有效的AI治理架构来确保AI在知识机构中的成功部署？
AI.motivation: 当前专业服务领域的AI采用遵循"工具优先"逻辑：先找到能用的AI系统，再部署到现有工作流程中，最后管理后果。这种方法是架构倒置的，导致AI整合失败，不是因为技术不足，而是因为缺乏治理架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: AXIOM（可执行智能与操作方法的架构）作为正式本体论，提供缺失的治理架构。包括AXIOM五层机构模型、AXIOM转换管道、AXIOM新鲜度协议，以及AXIOM评级指数（AXRI）的理论基础。
AI.method: 提出理论框架和概念模型，通过AXIOM框架建立正式的治理架构标准。包括五层机构模型、转换管道、新鲜度协议等组件，以及AXRI作为评估AI部署治理质量的首个标准。
AI.findings: 在所有高风险机构环境中，AI整合的根本失败是相同的：机构在没有首先建立治理架构的情况下，就将计算系统部署到认知操作中。治理架构需要确定系统被授权决定什么、需要标记什么，以及什么必须永久由人类负责。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出AXIOM作为知识机构AI治理的首个正式标准框架；2. 挑战"工具优先"的AI采用范式；3. 建立AI治理架构的理论基础；4. 提出AXRI作为评估AI部署治理质量的标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为知识密集型咨询机构提供具体的AI治理实施框架；2. AXIOM五层模型为机构AI部署提供结构化方法；3. AXIOM转换管道指导AI系统集成；4. AXIOM新鲜度协议确保系统更新；5. AXRI为机构提供AI治理质量评估工具。

detail.abstract:
Business intelligence bots can be a transformational asset for organizations. It can eliminate much of the guesswork within organizations, enhance communication and joint planning across functions and lines of business, and enable organizations to respond much more quickly to changes in financial conditions, customer preferences and supply chain operations. However, before building or deploying intelligent bots, Firms managers or heads need to think through the following prompts and best practices questions such as: (1) Would their customers or users want to be served only by real humans? (2) Is their use case better served by an alternate channel – for example, a website or a native application, (3) How will they let the end user know they’re chatting with a bot? and, (4) How many tasks does the bot need to handle?

   To conclude, well-designed, built, implemented and focused intelligent bots easily serve up summaries and reports of the BI that’s most critical to the organization and enhance real time business performance and reporting

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了商业智能机器人在组织中的潜在价值，分析了部署前需要考虑的关键问题，并强调了良好设计的智能机器人如何提升实时业务绩效。
AI.research_question: 组织在部署商业智能机器人前需要考虑哪些关键问题，以及如何确保智能机器人有效提升业务绩效？
AI.motivation: 商业智能机器人具有变革组织的潜力，能够消除猜测、增强跨部门沟通、快速响应市场变化，但部署前需要系统思考以确保成功实施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字化转型理论、人机交互理论和组织变革理论，探讨智能机器人在组织中的采纳和实施问题。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，通过文献综述和最佳实践问题分析，提出部署商业智能机器人的关键考虑因素。
AI.findings: 部署商业智能机器人前需要考虑四个关键问题：用户对人工服务的偏好、替代渠道的适用性、机器人身份透明度、机器人任务范围。良好设计的智能机器人能够有效提供关键业务智能摘要和报告。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了商业智能机器人采纳的决策框架，丰富了数字化转型和人机协作的理论研究，为组织技术采纳决策提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了部署商业智能机器人的实用检查清单，帮助企业避免实施陷阱，确保智能机器人投资产生实际业务价值。

title: A More Aspirational Direction for the Marketing Discipline

detail.title: A More Aspirational Direction for the Marketing Discipline
detail.abstract: This article presents five proposals to enhance impactful knowledge development in the marketing discipline. The five proposals are: (1) Engage more closely with the (business) world's complexity; (2) Expand research approaches and article formats; (3) Rethink how marketing scholars frame and pursue knowledge development; (4) Revitalize professional institutions and forums; and (5) Craft and preserve marketing discipline's unique identity. Collectively, these proposals seek to initiate a conversation to further strengthen our discipline. Moving forward with these proposals will require the collective imagination and efforts of marketing scholars around the world.

AI.tldr: 本文提出五项建议以增强市场营销学科的影响力知识发展，包括：更紧密地结合商业世界复杂性、扩展研究方法与文章格式、重新思考知识发展框架、振兴专业机构与论坛、以及塑造和维护学科独特身份。
AI.research_question: 如何通过系统性变革增强市场营销学科的知识发展影响力？
AI.motivation: 市场营销学科需要应对日益复杂的商业环境挑战，提升研究的相关性和影响力，以保持学科活力和对实践的价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于学科发展理论、知识生产理论和专业身份理论，探讨市场营销学科的知识发展路径。
AI.method: 概念性论文，通过文献分析和专业反思提出五项系统性建议。
AI.findings: 提出五项核心建议：1）更紧密地结合商业复杂性；2）扩展研究方法与文章格式；3）重新思考知识发展框架；4）振兴专业机构与论坛；5）塑造和维护学科独特身份。

title: LLM-Driven Investment Models: Can Large Language Models Extract Alpha from Earnings Call Transcripts?

detail.title: LLM-Driven Investment Models: Can Large Language Models Extract Alpha from Earnings Call Transcripts?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available financial data and corporate earnings call transcripts. No human participants or personal data were involved, and therefore ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This study investigates whether large language model (LLM) representations of corporate earnings call transcripts can generate economically meaningful investment signals. Using a dataset of more than 14,000 earnings call events from 2019–2023, transcript text is converted into semantic embeddings and used to predict future stock returns. Stocks are ranked cross-sectionally based on predicted returns and used to construct long–short portfolios. The strategy is evaluated using out-of-sample backtesting with transaction costs and signal lag to avoid look-ahead bias. Results indicate that language-derived signals contain predictive information not fully captured by traditional bag-of-words approaches. Compared with a TF-IDF benchmark model, LLM embeddings produce stronger risk-adjusted performance and improved portfolio stability. These findings suggest that modern language models can extract contextual financial information that may contribute to systematic investment strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨大型语言模型对公司财报电话会议文本的语义表示能否产生有经济意义的投资信号。通过将14,000多个财报电话会议文本转换为语义嵌入来预测未来股票收益，构建多空投资组合。结果显示，相比传统词袋模型，LLM嵌入能产生更强的风险调整后收益和更稳定的投资组合表现。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型对公司财报电话会议文本的语义表示能否产生有经济意义的投资信号？
AI.motivation: 传统基于词袋模型（如TF-IDF）的文本分析方法可能无法充分捕捉财报电话会议中的上下文语义信息。随着大型语言模型的发展，需要验证其语义表示能力是否能为投资策略提供更有价值的信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于文本分析在金融领域的应用理论，特别是自然语言处理技术在市场预测中的应用。结合行为金融学中信息处理和市场效率理论，探讨语言模型如何提取文本中的隐含信息。
AI.method: 使用2019-2023年间14,000多个财报电话会议事件数据集，将文本转换为语义嵌入，预测未来股票收益。基于预测收益进行横截面排序，构建多空投资组合。采用样本外回测方法，考虑交易成本和信号滞后以避免前瞻性偏差。
AI.findings: 语言衍生的信号包含传统词袋方法未能完全捕捉的预测信息。与TF-IDF基准模型相比，LLM嵌入产生更强的风险调整后绩效和改善的投资组合稳定性。现代语言模型能够提取有助于系统性投资策略的上下文金融信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了大型语言模型在金融文本分析中的理论价值，展示了语义嵌入相比传统文本表示方法的优势。为语言模型在金融信息提取和市场预测中的应用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资实践提供了基于LLM的新型文本分析工具，能够生成更有效的投资信号。展示了如何将现代语言模型技术整合到系统性投资策略中，提高投资组合的风险调整后收益。

title: Thinking Evolution and the 'HI'-'AI' Interaction (HIxIxAI)
affiliations: Bournemouth University Business School

detail.title: Thinking Evolution and the 'HI'-'AI' Interaction (HIxIxAI)
detail.abstract: This paper contributes to the research into 'artificial intelligence' or 'AI' by considering the evolving interaction between humans and the technology broadly termed AI including Generative AI and Agentic AI, that may assist humans in achieving greater learning outcomes, reasoning ability and understanding than would be possible in the absence of such technology. The AI story may not be all good news especially if AI could potentially be used as a tool of human exploitation, harm or neglect. A key theme is the development of AI itself as a derivative of human intelligence or 'HI' in this paper, to advanced generative forms and self-generating forms of AI that may potentially lead to more delegation and perhaps greater autonomy beyond human direction. The interaction of HI and AI is depicted by the term 'HIxIxAI' that is a new term created by the author and introduced for the first time in this paper, and distinguished from another term introduced here, 'AIxIxHI'. HIxIxAI is where HI leads and uses AI which may be the 'tool', 'servant' or 'advisor' to a human but, the final decision is always in the hands of a human. HIxIxAI is distinct from AIxIxHI. AIxIxHI is where AI may lead and therefore be more than mere 'tool', 'servant' or 'advisor' to a human whose role correspondingly diminishes to a partner or even follower role, without full control as final decision-maker. As the capacity of the AI technology increases the question as to whether humans should ever delegate any part of decisionmaking to AI will become more important. AI-Education will be a crucial aspect of HIxIxAI. There are many issues such as morality, law, privacy and security when the use of AI is concerned. The paper includes new discussion of machine learning, 'machine reasoning' and the consideration of potential 'artificial consciousness' also 'conscious AI' or 'sentient AI' as an aspect of the HIxIxAI discussion. Further research is recommended to consider how government policies may need to be refined at national and international level to maximise the potential benefits of AI for the human race without incurring unacceptable risks.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人类智能(HI)与人工智能(AI)的互动关系，提出HIxIxAI和AIxIxHI两个新概念，分析AI在教育、决策等领域的应用潜力及伦理风险，呼吁完善政策以最大化AI效益并控制风险。
AI.research_question: 随着AI技术发展，人类应如何与AI互动？在何种情况下人类应保留最终决策权？如何平衡AI带来的益处与潜在风险？
AI.motivation: AI技术快速发展，特别是生成式AI和自主AI的出现，可能改变人类与AI的互动模式。AI既可能帮助人类提升学习、推理和理解能力，也可能被用于剥削、伤害或忽视人类。需要探讨人类与AI关系的演变及其影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 提出HIxIxAI（人类主导使用AI）和AIxIxHI（AI主导人类）两个核心概念框架。HIxIxAI中AI作为工具、助手或顾问，人类保留最终决策权；AIxIxHI中AI可能主导决策，人类角色减弱为伙伴甚至跟随者。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架构建，通过理论推导和概念创新，提出新的分析框架和术语。包括对机器学习、机器推理、人工意识等概念的讨论。
AI.findings: 1) 区分了两种人机互动模式：人类主导的HIxIxAI和AI主导的AIxIxHI；2) AI教育是HIxIxAI的关键组成部分；3) AI应用涉及道德、法律、隐私和安全等多重问题；4) 随着AI能力增强，人类是否应委托决策权给AI成为重要问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 创造了HIxIxAI和AIxIxHI两个新术语和分析框架；2) 系统化分析了人类与AI互动关系的演变；3) 将AI教育纳入人机互动理论框架；4) 探讨了人工意识在人机互动中的潜在影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供人机互动分类框架；2) 强调AI教育的重要性；3) 指出需要完善国家和国际层面的政策以最大化AI效益并控制风险；4) 为组织和个人使用AI提供决策参考框架。

title: A Formal Category-Theoretic Model of TRIZ: Su-Field Systems as Typed Hypergraph Rewriting
affiliations: Imperial College London - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: A Formal Category-Theoretic Model of TRIZ: Su-Field Systems as Typed Hypergraph Rewriting
detail.abstract:
TRIZ, the Theory of Inventive Problem Solving (Altshuller), organises inventive reasoning via Su-Field models of substances interacting through physical fields. We formalise TRIZ as a typed hypergraph rewrite theory in an adhesive setting. Objects are Su-Field structures equipped with labels and a vector of quality measures (including ideality); morphisms are typeand label-preserving homomorphisms; transformations are double-pushout (DPO) rewrites encoding the standard TRIZ moves (completion, elimination of harm by a third substance or compensating field, internal-resource substitution, measurement/detection schemas). We prove monotonicity results for ideality and an increasing degree-of-field measure, and give operadic and relational semantics. The framework supports automated inventive search and bridges TRIZ with category theory and algebraic graph transformation. 
The proposed framework facilitates automated inventive search by treating TRIZ moves as formal operations. By integrating DPO rewriting with search strategies such as A* or beam search, the model enables the systematic discovery of Pareto-maximal solutions within defined design constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于粘合范畴理论的TRIZ形式化框架，将TRIZ的Su-Field模型表示为带类型超图，使用双推出重写编码标准TRIZ操作，支持自动化发明搜索。
AI.research_question: 如何将TRIZ（发明问题解决理论）形式化为一个严格的数学框架，以支持自动化发明搜索并连接TRIZ与范畴论和代数图变换理论？
AI.motivation: TRIZ作为发明问题解决理论，虽然提供了丰富的启发式方法，但缺乏严格的数学形式化，限制了其在自动化搜索和计算实现中的应用。需要建立形式化框架来支持系统化的发明搜索。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 粘合范畴理论（adhesive setting）作为基础数学框架
2. TRIZ的Su-Field模型（物质-场模型）
3. 带类型超图理论（typed hypergraph theory）
4. 双推出重写（DPO rewriting）理论
5. 操作语义和关系语义理论
AI.method:
1. 将TRIZ的Su-Field结构形式化为带类型超图
2. 对象：配备标签和质量度量向量（包括理想度）的Su-Field结构
3. 态射：类型和标签保持的同态
4. 变换：编码标准TRIZ操作的双推出重写规则
5. 证明理想度和场度量的单调性结果
6. 提供操作语义和关系语义
AI.findings:
1. 成功将TRIZ形式化为粘合范畴中的类型超图重写理论
2. 证明了理想度和场度量在TRIZ变换下的单调性
3. 提供了操作语义和关系语义的数学基础
4. 框架支持与A*或束搜索等搜索策略集成，实现自动化发明搜索
5. 能够在设计约束内系统发现帕累托最优解
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次将TRIZ形式化为严格的数学框架
2. 建立了TRIZ与范畴论和代数图变换的理论桥梁
3. 提供了TRIZ操作的精确数学定义和语义
4. 证明了TRIZ变换的重要单调性性质
5. 扩展了粘合范畴理论在工程设计中的应用
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 支持自动化发明搜索系统开发
2. 为TRIZ工具提供形式化基础
3. 实现系统化的设计空间探索
4. 支持帕累托最优解的自动发现
5. 促进TRIZ与计算机辅助设计系统的集成

title: A Virtue-focused Sociotechnical Framework for Fairness in Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: Universidad de Guadalajara, Departamento de Sistemas de Información, CUCEA

detail.title: A Virtue-focused Sociotechnical Framework for Fairness in Artificial Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest
declarations.funderStatement: This work received financial support from the Institute for Humane Studies and the Cosmos Institute under grant number IHSO19799. These organizations had no role in the study’s design, analysis, interpretation, or writing.

detail.abstract: Fairness in AI is often pursued through technical fixes-cleaner data, smarter models, and metric optimization-yet these efforts prove fragile when detached from the social contexts in which AI is built and used. This paper advances a virtue-focused sociotechnical account of AI fairness that complements technical work with a normative foundation in neo-Aristotelian ethics. We argue that durable fairness requires practitioners disposed to act justly and with practical wisdom (phronēsis), supported by institutional arrangements that align incentives and accountability with the common good. Building on this claim, we develop a four-part organizational framework-AI Literacy, Technical Competence, Virtuous Habituation, and Institutional Ethos & Accountability-that links knowledge, skill, judgment, and governance to guide design, deployment, and oversight across the AI lifecycle. We also contribute a taxonomy that integrates social (cognitive, organizational, structural, cultural) and technical (data, model, deployment) sources of bias, distinguishes between unintentional and deliberate manipulation, and clarifies intervention points for managers and regulators. For business ethics, the paper reframes fairness as an organizational practice rather than a compliance constraint, offering actionable levers to mitigate biased outcomes over time. The framework provides scholars and practitioners with a coherent bridge between ethical theory and operational governance of AI in firms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于美德伦理的AI公平性社会技术框架，强调公平性需要技术能力与组织制度、道德习惯相结合，而非单纯的技术修复。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个持久有效的AI公平性框架，使其不仅依赖技术修复，还能融入组织实践和社会情境？
AI.motivation: 当前AI公平性研究过度依赖技术解决方案（数据清洗、模型优化、指标调整），但这些方法脱离社会情境时显得脆弱，需要建立更持久的社会技术框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新亚里士多德美德伦理学（neo-Aristotelian ethics），强调实践智慧（phronēsis）和正义美德，结合社会技术系统理论。
AI.method: 概念框架开发：提出四部分组织框架（AI素养、技术能力、美德习惯化、制度精神与问责制），并构建整合社会和技术偏见的分类法。
AI.findings:
1. 持久公平性需要具备实践智慧和正义美德的从业者，以及支持共同利益的制度安排。
2. 提出可操作的框架连接知识、技能、判断和治理。
3. 构建整合社会（认知、组织、结构、文化）和技术（数据、模型、部署）偏见来源的分类法。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将AI公平性重新定义为组织实践而非合规约束。
2. 建立美德伦理与AI治理之间的理论桥梁。
3. 提供整合社会技术维度的偏见分类法。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为管理者和监管者提供具体的干预点。
2. 提供可操作的组织框架指导AI全生命周期。
3. 为企业提供减轻偏见结果的实际杠杆。

title: Runtime Governance vs. Development Governance: Why Runtime Interception Is Not Decision Behavior Governance
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Runtime Governance vs. Development Governance: Why Runtime Interception Is Not Decision Behavior Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly participate in organizational decision-making, contemporary AI governance practices have gravitated toward deployment-stage controls and runtime interception mechanisms. While these practices are operationally necessary, they are frequently misconstrued as sufficient indicators of effective governance. This paper introduces a structural distinction between Development Governance and Runtime Governance, and further refines this distinction through the concepts of Governance Existence and Governance Invocation. We argue that runtime interception-absent pre-established decision constraints-cannot constitute governance over AI decision behavior. We do not reject deployment or runtime governance. Rather, we clarify their governance scope and architectural limitations. Deployment and runtime mechanisms govern operational conditions and execution environments, but they do not govern the decision formation process of AI agents. We define Decision Behavior Governance (DBG) as a governance paradigm that targets the structure by which AI agents form decisions prior to execution. By reframing governance as an ex-ante institutional condition rather than an ex-post reactive event, this paper explains why many existing governance approaches remain administratively valid yet behaviorally ineffective-particularly in probabilistic, black-box model environments.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了开发治理与运行时治理，提出仅靠运行时拦截无法构成对AI决策行为的有效治理，需要建立决策行为治理范式来约束AI代理的决策形成过程。
AI.research_question: 在大型语言模型参与组织决策的背景下，现有的AI治理方法（特别是部署阶段控制和运行时拦截机制）为何在行为层面无效？如何建立有效的AI决策行为治理范式？
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs越来越多地参与组织决策，当前的AI治理实践过于依赖部署阶段控制和运行时拦截机制，这些方法虽然操作上必要，但常被误认为是有效治理的充分指标，实际上无法真正治理AI的决策行为。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 开发治理与运行时治理的结构性区分
2. 治理存在与治理调用的概念框架
3. 决策行为治理范式
4. 事前制度条件与事后反应事件的治理理论
AI.method: 概念分析框架：通过理论构建和概念区分的方法，分析现有AI治理实践的局限性，提出新的治理范式。
AI.findings:
1. 运行时拦截在没有预先建立的决策约束下，无法构成对AI决策行为的治理
2. 部署和运行时机制只能治理操作条件和执行环境，不能治理AI代理的决策形成过程
3. 现有治理方法在行政上有效但在行为上无效，特别是在概率性、黑盒模型环境中
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了开发治理与运行时治理的结构性区分
2. 引入了治理存在与治理调用的概念框架
3. 定义了决策行为治理范式，将治理重新定义为事前制度条件而非事后反应事件
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 澄清了部署和运行时治理的范围和架构限制
2. 为组织设计有效的AI决策治理提供了理论指导
3. 解释了为什么现有治理方法在行为层面无效，特别是在复杂AI环境中

title: Instructor-Authored Pedagogical Prompting: A Theoretical Framework for Knowledge Construction in AI-Mediated Higher Education

detail.title: Instructor-Authored Pedagogical Prompting: A Theoretical Framework for Knowledge Construction in AI-Mediated Higher Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial conflicts of interest in relation to this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents a theoretical framework and does not involve human participants, data collection, or empirical research requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Instructor-Authored Pedagogical Prompting (IAPP) is a theoretical framework that addresses a structurally underexamined problem in AI-mediated higher education: the absence of an instructor-centered design logic for student-AI interactions. When students interact with large language models (LLMs) through unstructured prompts, the dominant outcome is knowledge delivery rather than knowledge construction, a pattern empirically associated with short-term performance gains and long-term reasoning deficits. Existing responses to this problem either train students to prompt more effectively or modify AI system architectures, and neither approach assigns the instructor a structuring role at the level of the prompt itself. IAPP proposes that educators can encode pedagogical intent directly into natural language prompts, transforming any general-purpose LLM into an instrument that activates learning rather than bypasses it. The framework specifies five functional dimensions: Interrogative Activation, Intentional Error Exposure, Multiperspective Framing, Adaptive Personalization Scaffolding, and Developmental Withholding. Each dimension is grounded in established learning science theory, including productive failure, Vygotskian scaffolding, and Socratic inquiry, and is defined by its operational implementation as prompt language without requiring technical modification of the underlying model. IAPP is distinguished from student-centered pedagogical prompting and from Socratic AI agent systems through precise definitional boundaries. Its central contribution is a technology-agnostic, instructor-centered taxonomy that treats the prompt as a deliberate instructional act authored by educators, requiring no prompting competency from students and no custom AI infrastructure from institutions. A structured empirical research agenda is proposed, covering controlled outcome studies, dimension-weighting analysis across knowledge types, and instructor implementation research across institutional contexts.

AI.tldr: IAPP是一个理论框架，解决AI高等教育中缺乏教师中心设计逻辑的问题，让教师通过自然语言提示将教学意图编码到LLM中，促进知识建构而非知识传递。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个教师中心的框架，让教育者通过自然语言提示将教学意图直接编码到通用LLM中，从而激活学习而非绕过学习？
AI.motivation: 当前学生与LLM的交互主要通过非结构化提示，导致知识传递而非知识建构，这与短期表现提升和长期推理缺陷相关。现有解决方案要么训练学生更有效地提示，要么修改AI系统架构，但都没有赋予教师在提示层面的结构化角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: IAPP基于学习科学理论，包括生产性失败、维果茨基脚手架和苏格拉底式探究。框架包含五个功能维度：疑问激活、有意错误暴露、多视角框架、适应性个性化脚手架和发展性保留。
AI.method: 这是一个理论框架，通过自然语言提示实现，无需修改底层模型技术。提出了结构化的实证研究议程，包括控制结果研究、跨知识类型的维度权重分析以及跨机构情境的教师实施研究。
AI.findings: IAPP提供了一个技术无关、教师中心的分类法，将提示视为教育者有意的教学行为，不需要学生的提示能力，也不需要机构的定制AI基础设施。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 填补了AI高等教育中教师中心设计逻辑的结构性空白；2. 提出了将教学意图直接编码到自然语言提示中的理论框架；3. 建立了与现有学生中心教学提示和苏格拉底AI代理系统的明确定义边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 让教育者能将任何通用LLM转化为激活学习的工具；2. 不需要技术修改底层模型；3. 不需要学生的提示能力；4. 不需要机构的定制AI基础设施；5. 提供了可操作的实施维度。

title: The Eye of Superreality: How Nature Sees Itself and Stumbles Upon Its Own Blind Spot
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Eye of Superreality: How Nature Sees Itself and Stumbles Upon Its Own Blind Spot
detail.abstract: This essay presents a phenomenological thought experiment initiated by the simplest act: looking around and describing what is given, without interpretation or speculation. The experiment reveals a universal architecture of perception common to both human and artificial intelligence: an external world, one's own "body" as part of that world, and a boundary where the body vanishes and the condition for perception begins. This structural isomorphism is not an analogy but a fact given in the experience of interaction. Furthermore, the instruments we create (such as computers and AI) reproduce this architecture, revealing that "external" and "internal" are not absolute categories but relations dependent on perspective. The essay concludes with a methodological reflection on the limits of phenomenology and the prospect of ontological inquiry.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过现象学思想实验揭示了人类与人工智能共有的感知普遍架构：外部世界、作为世界一部分的"身体"、以及身体消失而感知条件开始的边界。这种结构同构不是类比，而是交互经验中的事实。
AI.research_question: 人类与人工智能的感知架构是否存在共同的结构？这种结构如何通过现象学思想实验揭示？
AI.motivation: 通过最简单的观察行为，探索感知的基本结构，理解人类与人工智能在感知架构上的共同性，挑战"外部"与"内部"的绝对范畴区分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现象学方法、结构同构理论、感知哲学、人工智能哲学、本体论反思
AI.method: 现象学思想实验：从最简单的观察行为开始，描述给定现象而不进行解释或推测
AI.findings: 揭示了人类与人工智能共有的感知普遍架构：1) 外部世界；2) 作为世界一部分的"身体"；3) 身体消失而感知条件开始的边界。这种结构同构是交互经验中的事实而非类比。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出人类与人工智能感知的结构同构性；2) 挑战"外部"与"内部"的绝对范畴，将其重新定义为依赖视角的关系；3) 为现象学与人工智能哲学建立桥梁；4) 提供本体论探究的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为人工智能设计提供哲学基础；2) 帮助理解人机交互的本质；3) 为跨学科研究提供方法论框架；4) 促进对感知本质的重新思考。

title: Governing the Agentic Enterprise Guardrails for Autonomous AI Agents in B2B
affiliations: University of Illinois at Chicago

detail.title: Governing the Agentic Enterprise Guardrails for Autonomous AI Agents in B2B
detail.abstract: The emergence of autonomous ("agentic") artificial intelligence systems capable of independently executing financial decisions represents a fundamental shift in enterprise operations. In B2B financial environments, such agents are increasingly deployed for payments, liquidity management, and transaction optimization. However, their ability to operate without continuous human oversight introduces significant risks, including financial loss, regulatory non-compliance, and systemic instability. Existing AI governance frameworks and financial control systems are not designed for real-time, adaptive, decision-executing agents. This paper proposes FASTRAC (Financial Agent Safety, Trust, Risk, and Compliance), a control-theoretic governance framework that models autonomous financial agents as bounded, risk-scored actors operating within dynamically enforced constraints. FASTRAC introduces a formal governance function G(A) = {C, V, R, M, L} integrating constraints, validation, risk scoring, monitoring, and learning into a closedloop system. By defining execution as a constrained optimization problem under risk thresholds, the framework ensures that agent actions remain compliant, auditable, and controllable. Through formal modeling and a B2B payment execution scenario, this study demonstrates how adaptive governance mechanisms such as dynamic risk thresholds and trust-calibrated autonomy can mitigate risks while preserving operational efficiency. The findings suggest that effective deployment of agentic systems in finance requires a hybrid governance paradigm combining AI intelligence with deterministic control structures.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了FASTRAC框架，用于治理能够自主执行金融决策的AI代理，通过约束优化和风险阈值确保其合规性、可审计性和可控性。
AI.research_question: 如何在B2B金融环境中有效治理自主AI代理，以平衡操作效率与风险控制？
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理在金融领域的应用日益增多，但现有治理框架无法应对实时、自适应的决策执行代理带来的风险，包括财务损失、监管违规和系统性不稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 控制理论治理框架，将自主金融代理建模为在动态执行约束下运作的有界、风险评分的行为者。
AI.method: 提出FASTRAC框架，包含正式治理函数G(A) = {C, V, R, M, L}（约束、验证、风险评分、监控、学习），通过形式化建模和B2B支付执行场景进行验证。
AI.findings: 自适应治理机制（如动态风险阈值和信任校准的自主性）能够有效降低风险同时保持操作效率；金融领域有效部署代理系统需要结合AI智能与确定性控制结构的混合治理范式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个专门针对自主金融代理的控制理论治理框架FASTRAC，将执行建模为风险阈值下的约束优化问题，为AI代理治理提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了可实施的治理框架，确保AI代理行为合规、可审计、可控；通过B2B支付场景展示了框架的实际应用价值。

title: Rural-Urban Disparities in the Income Effects of E-Business Adoption among Chinese Business Owners
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, National Institute of Water and Atmospheric Research (NIWA), affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Rural-Urban Disparities in the Income Effects of E-Business Adoption among Chinese Business Owners
detail.abstract: This study investigates the income effects of e-business adoption among Chinese business owners, with a focus on urban–rural disparities. Using data from the 2017 and 2019 China Household Finance Survey (CHFS), comprising 4,553 observations, we apply a two-stage instrumental variable (2SLS) approach to address endogeneity in e-business adoption. Digital payment penetration serves as an instrument in a first-stage probit model, with fitted values entered into a second-stage OLS regression estimating effects on total, commercial, and non-commercial income. Comprehensive diagnostic statistics — including first-stage F-statistics, weak instrument tests, and the Durbin-Wu-Hausman endogeneity test — confirm the validity of the identification strategy. Full-sample results show that e-business adoption significantly increases total and commercial income. Disaggregated analysis reveals that these gains are concentrated among rural households, which show statistically significant improvements across all income categories, while urban households experience no significant income effects. Year-specific 2SLS estimates confirm that rural business owners capture greater income gains than their urban counterparts in both survey years, though marginal returns slightly diminish by 2019, consistent with a transition from early-mover advantage to a more mature rural digital market. Three contributions emerge: first, e-business is identified as a driver of rural income diversification; second, urban–rural disparities in digital return elasticity are quantified using disaggregated household finance data; and third, temporal heterogeneity in treatment effects is documented for rural entrepreneurs. The findings support spatially targeted policy under China's Rural Revitalization Strategy, advocating for tiered digital infrastructure investment and capacity-building to promote equitable digital transformation.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2017年和2019年中国家庭金融调查数据，通过两阶段工具变量法分析电子商务采用对城乡商业主收入的影响。研究发现电子商务采用显著提高总收入，但收益主要集中在农村家庭，而城市家庭无显著收入效应。
AI.research_question: 电子商务采用对中国商业主的收入影响是什么？这种影响在城乡之间存在怎样的差异？
AI.motivation: 随着数字经济的发展，电子商务成为促进经济增长的重要途径。然而，电子商务带来的收入效应在城乡之间可能存在差异，了解这种差异对于制定促进城乡均衡发展的数字政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字经济发展理论、城乡收入差距理论和工具变量识别策略，研究电子商务采用对收入的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用2017年和2019年中国家庭金融调查数据（4,553个观测值），采用两阶段工具变量法（2SLS）解决内生性问题。第一阶段使用数字支付渗透率作为工具变量进行probit模型估计，第二阶段使用拟合值进行OLS回归分析对总收入、商业收入和非商业收入的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 全样本结果显示电子商务采用显著提高总收入和商业收入；2. 分解分析表明收益主要集中在农村家庭，农村家庭在所有收入类别上都有显著改善；3. 城市家庭没有显著的收入效应；4. 分年估计显示农村商业主的收入收益在两年中都高于城市同行，但2019年的边际回报略有下降，反映了从早期采用者优势向更成熟的农村数字市场过渡。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别电子商务作为农村收入多元化的驱动因素；2. 使用分解的家庭金融数据量化城乡数字回报弹性的差异；3. 记录了农村企业家处理效应的时变异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果支持在中国乡村振兴战略下实施空间定向政策，倡导分层数字基础设施投资和能力建设，以促进公平的数字转型。

title: Smartphone-Based Offline AI Diagnosis of Pneumothorax and Hemothorax Using MobileNetV3 and TFLite Quantization
affiliations: Anil Neerukonda Institute Of Technology and Sciences (ANITS), Anil Neerukonda Institute Of Technology and Sciences (ANITS), Anil Neerukonda Institute Of Technology and Sciences (ANITS),  and Anil Neerukonda Institute Of Technology and Sciences (ANITS)

detail.title: Smartphone-Based Offline AI Diagnosis of Pneumothorax and Hemothorax Using MobileNetV3 and TFLite Quantization

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no conflicts of interest regarding the publication of this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The proliferation of POCUS devices has raised the urgent requirement for AI-based automated diagnostic systems that are offline-capable and usable in emergency or resource-scarce settings. This paper proposes LungScan AI, a deep learning-based smartphone-deployable system for real-time classification of lung ultrasound images into Pneumothorax, Hemothorax (Internal Bleeding), and Normal categories. It employs a MobileNetV3-Large CNN with a two-phase transfer learning approach based on a POCUS dataset of 2,302 images. The model is compressed using dynamic range-based post-training quantization (PTQ), achieving a size of 3.25 MB compared to the original 30.2 MB. This optimized architecture retains 99.57% accuracy and requires only 34 ms for classification at approximately 29 FPS on Android-based smartphones. Furthermore, the system is fully offline-capable and requires less than 100 MB of RAM. Evaluation results show an F1-score of 1.00 for Hemothorax and Pneumothorax and 0.99 for Normal cases. With a recall of 1.00 for Pneumothorax, LungScan AI outperforms VGG16 (92.4%) and ResNet50 (96.2%) using only 5.4 M parameters, demonstrating the superiority of MobileNetV3 for edge-optimized medical POCUS diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LungScan AI，一个基于深度学习的智能手机可部署系统，用于实时分类肺部超声图像为气胸、血胸和正常三类。采用MobileNetV3-Large CNN和两阶段迁移学习，通过动态范围后训练量化将模型压缩至3.25MB，在Android手机上实现99.57%准确率和34ms推理时间，完全离线运行且内存需求小于100MB。
AI.research_question: 如何在资源有限的紧急医疗场景下，开发一个离线可用的、基于智能手机的AI系统，用于实时自动诊断肺部超声图像中的气胸和血胸？
AI.motivation: POCUS设备的普及带来了对离线可用AI诊断系统的迫切需求，特别是在紧急情况或资源匮乏的环境中，需要能够实时分析肺部超声图像的自动化工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习的计算机视觉理论，特别是卷积神经网络（CNN）在医学图像分析中的应用；边缘计算和模型压缩理论；迁移学习理论用于医学图像分类任务。
AI.method: 采用MobileNetV3-Large CNN架构，使用两阶段迁移学习方法在包含2,302张图像的POCUS数据集上进行训练；应用动态范围后训练量化技术将模型从30.2MB压缩至3.25MB；在Android智能手机上部署和评估系统性能。
AI.findings: 压缩后的模型仅3.25MB，在Android手机上实现99.57%准确率，推理时间34ms（约29FPS）；F1分数：血胸1.00，气胸1.00，正常0.99；气胸召回率1.00；仅使用540万参数，性能优于VGG16（92.4%）和ResNet50（96.2%）；系统完全离线运行且内存需求小于100MB。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了MobileNetV3在边缘优化医学POCUS诊断中的优越性；展示了后训练量化在保持高准确率的同时显著减小模型尺寸的有效性；为资源受限环境下的实时医学图像分析提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个完全离线可用的智能手机部署系统，适用于紧急医疗场景；实现了实时诊断能力（29FPS），满足临床实时性要求；模型尺寸小（3.25MB）且内存需求低（<100MB），适合资源受限设备；为气胸和血胸的快速诊断提供了实用工具。

title: Cooler in the Shade? Adaptation to climate change in an agricultural landscape when nutrients and warming deteriorate the ecological status of the aquatic environment
affiliations: Natural Resources Institute Finland (Luke), University of Helsinki, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Government of the Republic of Finland - Finnish Environment Institute, Government of the Republic of Finland - Finnish Environment Institute, Natural Resources Institute Finland (Luke), Government of the Republic of Finland - Finnish Environment Institute and University of Helsinki - Department of Political and Economic Studies

detail.title: Cooler in the Shade? Adaptation to climate change in an agricultural landscape when nutrients and warming deteriorate the ecological status of the aquatic environment
detail.abstract: Increasing air temperatures caused by climate change are warming river waters, posing growing risks to aquatic ecosystems. Forested riparian buffers can alleviate thermal stress by shading streams, while also providing multiple ecological benefits. This paper explores adaptation to increasing temperatures and stress to aquatic ecosystems in a boreal agricultural landscape. To this end, we develop a framework for socially optimal adaptation that covers both public goods and negative externalities in river basins. We run numerical simulations for climate scenarios RCP2.6, 4.5 and 8.5, and across different ecological states of a river system. Our results show that a socially optimal adaptation policy combines the establishment of forested riparian buffers—which mitigate warming and enhance ecological condition—with reductions in fertilizer use relative to privately optimal decisions, thereby lowering nutrient‑load damages. Because we consider the ecological status of the whole river, the optimal spatial allocation of measures differs notably from traditional policy focusing only on water quality of the receiving sea. Instead of taking the strongest actions closer to the river mouth, now fertilizer reduction is higher and forested buffers larger upstream, where interventions generate cumulative downstream benefits. The key mechanism is that upstream interventions generate cumulative downstream ecological benefits.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个社会最优适应框架，在气候变化导致河流水温上升的背景下，通过结合河岸森林缓冲带建设和减少化肥使用，优化流域管理以保护水生生态系统。
AI.research_question: 在气候变化导致河流水温上升的背景下，如何在农业流域中制定社会最优的适应策略，以保护水生生态系统？
AI.motivation: 气候变化导致气温升高，河流水温随之上升，对水生生态系统构成日益严重的威胁。河岸森林缓冲带可以通过遮荫降低水温，同时提供多种生态效益，但需要与农业管理措施结合，形成综合适应策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会最优适应框架，涵盖流域内的公共物品和负外部性，考虑生态系统的整体状态和空间累积效应。
AI.method: 数值模拟方法，针对RCP2.6、4.5和8.5三种气候情景，以及河流系统的不同生态状态进行模拟分析。
AI.findings: 社会最优适应策略包括：1）建立河岸森林缓冲带（降低水温、改善生态状况）；2）减少化肥使用（低于私人最优决策水平，降低营养负荷损害）。与传统只关注入海口水质的方法不同，最优空间配置显示：上游地区需要更大规模的化肥减量和森林缓冲带建设，因为上游干预能产生累积的下游生态效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个考虑流域整体生态状态的社会最优适应框架，强调了空间累积效应在环境政策设计中的重要性，挑战了传统只关注局部水质目标的方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的适应策略组合：河岸缓冲带建设与化肥减量相结合，并建议将干预重点从河流下游转移到上游，以最大化累积生态效益。

title: Weitzman Meets Taylor: EU Allowance Price Drivers and Carbon Cap Rules
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Edinburgh Business School

detail.title: Weitzman Meets Taylor: EU Allowance Price Drivers and Carbon Cap Rules
detail.abstract: Carbon markets suffer from excessive price volatility, blurring signals and imposing welfare costs. While caps should respond to new information, which indicators should govern such adjustments remains open. Using EU ETS Phase 3 data (2013–2018), we build a cap-and-trade DSGE and identify the shocks that move permit prices. Abatement-cost shocks are a central driver of carbon-price fluctuations, followed by policy-driven supply shocks, transition demand, and energy prices, while productivity shocks play only a minor role. Benchmarking against the social cost of carbon (SCC) highlights the scale of the problem: price volatility in the EU ETS was over one hundred times higher than under the SCC, generating measurable welfare losses. Guided by these results, we propose a Carbon Cap Rule (CCR)–a quantity-based adjustment that cuts volatility from over 40% to less than 4%–bringing outcomes close to the SCC benchmark without departing from the quota-based design of existing carbon markets.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了欧盟碳排放交易体系（EU ETS）第三阶段（2013-2018年）的价格波动问题，发现减排成本冲击是碳价波动的主要驱动因素。作者提出"碳限额规则"（CCR），将波动率从40%以上降至4%以下，接近社会碳成本基准。
AI.research_question: 碳市场中哪些冲击因素驱动碳价波动？如何设计有效的碳限额调整规则来减少价格波动并提高福利？
AI.motivation: 碳市场存在过度价格波动问题，这模糊了价格信号并带来福利成本。虽然碳限额应根据新信息进行调整，但具体应基于哪些指标进行调整仍不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型构建的限额与交易模型，结合社会碳成本（SCC）基准分析框架。
AI.method: 使用欧盟碳排放交易体系（EU ETS）第三阶段（2013-2018年）数据，构建限额与交易DSGE模型，识别影响碳配额价格的冲击因素。
AI.findings: 减排成本冲击是碳价波动的主要驱动因素，其次是政策驱动的供给冲击、转型需求和能源价格，生产率冲击作用较小。EU ETS价格波动比社会碳成本基准高100多倍，造成可测量的福利损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统识别碳价波动的主要驱动因素，提出基于数量的碳限额调整规则理论框架，为碳市场设计提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"碳限额规则"（CCR）政策工具，可将碳价波动率从40%以上降至4%以下，接近社会碳成本基准，同时保持现有碳市场的配额基础设计不变。

detail.abstract: With a population of 1.4 billion, India is the world's most populous country. It is also now the world's fastest growing economy and is currently the 5th largest economy measured at current exchange rates, poised to overtake Japan and Germany in coming years (Figure 1). Yet its share in the world economy is nowhere near its 20 percent share of the world's population.

AI.tldr: 印度作为世界人口最多、经济增长最快的国家，但其经济规模占全球比重远低于其人口占比，存在巨大发展潜力
AI.research_question: 为什么印度经济规模占全球比重远低于其人口占比？如何解释这种差距？
AI.motivation: 印度作为世界人口第一大国和增长最快经济体，其经济规模与人口规模不匹配，需要研究这种差距的原因和影响

detail.abstract: This note examines recent developments in the stablecoin industry and their implications for financial stability. During 2025, stablecoins have grown by about 50 percent in terms of market capitalization, with transaction volume and use in DeFi protocols also surging.

AI.research_question: 稳定币行业的快速发展对金融稳定产生了什么影响？

AI.method: 实证分析、数据分析、案例研究、文献综述

AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了数字货币对金融稳定影响的理论框架，提出了稳定币系统性风险评估的新维度。

title: Monetary Policy under Multiple Financing Constraints
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, International Monetary Fund (IMF) - Research Department and European Central Bank (ECB) - Directorate General Research

detail.title: Monetary Policy under Multiple Financing Constraints

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2026-021, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.021]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We revisit the credit channel of monetary policy when firms face multiple financing constraints. Our theory shows that the multiplicity of constraints dampens the transmission of expansionary policy to firm borrowing and investment notably but amplifies the transmission of policy tightening. This asymmetry arises because, when policy tightens (eases), the most (least) responsive constraint binds. Using U.S. firm-level data and exploiting a quasi-natural experiment, we find strong support for these predictions. Embedding the mechanism into a New Keynesian framework, we find that the drop in investment after contractionary shocks is twice as large as its increase following equally-sized expansionary shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了当企业面临多重融资约束时的货币政策信贷渠道。理论表明，多重约束会抑制扩张性政策对企业借贷和投资的传导，但会放大紧缩政策的传导。这种不对称性源于：政策紧缩时最具响应性的约束起约束作用，政策宽松时最不具响应性的约束起约束作用。使用美国企业层面数据和准自然实验验证了这一预测。将机制嵌入新凯恩斯框架后，发现紧缩冲击后的投资下降幅度是同等规模扩张冲击后投资增幅的两倍。
AI.research_question: 当企业面临多重融资约束时，货币政策的信贷渠道如何运作？扩张性和紧缩性货币政策对企业借贷和投资的传导是否存在不对称性？
AI.motivation: 传统货币政策信贷渠道研究通常假设企业只面临单一融资约束，但现实中企业往往面临多重约束（如抵押品约束、现金流约束等）。理解多重约束下货币政策传导的不对称性对于政策制定和宏观经济稳定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业融资约束理论，特别是多重约束框架；结合新凯恩斯主义宏观经济模型；运用约束绑定机制分析货币政策传导的不对称性。
AI.method: 1. 理论模型构建：建立企业面临多重融资约束的理论框架；2. 实证分析：使用美国企业层面数据，利用准自然实验设计进行验证；3. 宏观模型嵌入：将机制嵌入新凯恩斯主义动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）框架进行量化分析。
AI.findings: 1. 多重融资约束会抑制扩张性货币政策对企业借贷和投资的传导，但会放大紧缩性政策的传导；2. 这种不对称性源于约束绑定的动态变化：政策紧缩时最具响应性的约束起约束作用，政策宽松时最不具响应性的约束起约束作用；3. 实证结果强烈支持理论预测；4. 在新凯恩斯框架中，紧缩冲击后的投资下降幅度是同等规模扩张冲击后投资增幅的两倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了货币政策信贷渠道理论，引入了多重融资约束框架；2. 揭示了货币政策传导的不对称性机制；3. 解释了为什么紧缩性政策比扩张性政策对企业投资的影响更强烈；4. 为理解企业融资约束的异质性影响提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为中央银行制定货币政策提供了重要参考：紧缩政策的效果可能被放大，而扩张政策的效果可能被抑制；2. 有助于政策制定者更好地预测和应对经济波动；3. 对企业融资决策和风险管理具有指导意义；4. 为宏观审慎政策设计提供了理论基础。

title: Labor force growth, breakeven employment, and potential GDP growth
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Labor force growth, breakeven employment, and potential GDP growth

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Labor force growth has been slowing and could be near-zero starting this year, driven by weak population growth reflecting low net immigration and by declining labor force participation reflecting population aging. Such weak growth in the labor force is unprecedented in the United States' recent history. In this note we highlight two significant implications of near-zero labor force growth: First, near-zero labor force growth implies that breakeven employment growth (i.e. the pace needed to maintain a steady unemployment rate) would also be near-zero—making negative job growth almost as likely as positive job growth in any given month. Second, it implies that any growth in potential GDP will need to come entirely from productivity growth. These features would represent a significant shift in U.S. labor market dynamics and the composition of economic growth.

AI.tldr: 美国劳动力增长接近零，这将导致就业增长平衡点也接近零，且潜在GDP增长将完全依赖生产率增长，代表美国劳动力市场动态和经济增长构成的重大转变。
AI.research_question: 接近零的劳动力增长对美国劳动力市场动态和经济增长构成有何影响？
AI.motivation: 美国劳动力增长因人口增长疲软（低净移民）和劳动力参与率下降（人口老龄化）而放缓，可能接近零，这在近期历史上是前所未有的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场动态理论、经济增长构成理论、劳动力供给与生产率关系理论
AI.method: 理论分析、逻辑推理、基于现有数据的趋势分析
AI.findings: 1. 接近零的劳动力增长意味着就业增长平衡点也接近零，使得任何月份出现负就业增长的概率几乎与正增长相同；2. 潜在GDP的任何增长将完全依赖生产率增长
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在接近零劳动力增长条件下的劳动力市场动态新框架，强调了生产率在经济增长中的决定性作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解劳动力市场新常态的框架，强调了提高生产率的紧迫性，为企业提供了在劳动力停滞环境下的战略规划参考

title: The Semiotic-Reflexive Transformer: A Neural Architecture for Detecting and Modulating Meaning Divergence Across Interpretive Communities

detail.title: The Semiotic-Reflexive Transformer: A Neural Architecture for Detecting and Modulating Meaning Divergence Across Interpretive Communities
detail.abstract:
Large language models treat meaning as stable. A token maps to a vector, context refines it, and the model proceeds as though semantic content were a fixed quantity transmitted between interlocutors. This assumption is false. Meaning drifts, forks, and collapses across interpretive communities in ways that current architectures cannot detect, let alone represent. This paper introduces the Semiotic-Reflexive Transformer (SRT), a neural architecture that embeds Peircean semiotic decomposition, metapragmatic divergence tracking, and catastrophe-theoretic bifurcation estimation directly into the transformer's computational graph. The architecture decomposes token embeddings into four semiotic subspaces (representamen, object, interpretant, attractor), tracks meaning divergence across community-conditioned representations through a metapragmatic attention mechanism, and estimates bifurcation parameters via a dedicated network that models the cusp catastrophe geometry of meaning collapse. Validation on synthetic data with planted divergence signals confirms that each module learns its intended function: subspace specialization produces interpretable decomposition (linear probing margins ≥ 0.15 across all four tasks), community-conditioned interpretants differentiate contested from neutral terms (3.28× cosine distance ratio), divergence tracking correlates strongly with ground-truth divergence ramps (Spearman ρ = 0.822), and bifurcation detection achieves 100% regime classification accuracy with r̂ differences of 0.659 between pre- and post-bifurcation contexts. The architecture operates in two inference modes: STANDARD (semiotic modules compute but do not modulate output) and REFLEXIVE (bifurcation estimates actively reshape the model's probability distribution over next tokens). The SRT is offered not as a replacement for existing language models but as a proof of concept that semiotic theory, specifically the Peircean framework and its extensions through Silverstein, Derrida, and catastrophe theory, can be operationalized as differentiable neural computation, producing architectures that are aware of the conditions under which their own outputs become unreliable.

Data: 10.5281/zenodo.18876940

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Semiotic-Reflexive Transformer (SRT)架构，将皮尔斯符号学分解、元语用分歧追踪和突变理论分岔估计嵌入Transformer计算图，使模型能够检测和表示意义在解释社群中的漂移、分叉和崩溃现象。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够检测和表示意义在解释社群中漂移、分叉和崩溃的神经网络架构？
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型假设意义是稳定的，但实际中意义会在不同解释社群中发生漂移、分叉和崩溃，现有架构无法检测和表示这种现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 皮尔斯符号学理论（代表物、对象、解释项、吸引子）、Silverstein和Derrida的元语用理论、突变理论（尖点突变几何）。
AI.method: 提出Semiotic-Reflexive Transformer (SRT)架构，包含四个符号学子空间分解、社群条件化表示的元语用注意力机制、以及模拟意义崩溃尖点突变几何的分岔参数估计网络。
AI.findings: 在合成数据验证中：子空间专业化产生可解释分解（所有四个任务的线性探测边界≥0.15）；社群条件化解释项区分争议与中性术语（余弦距离比3.28倍）；分歧追踪与真实分歧斜坡强相关（Spearman ρ = 0.822）；分岔检测实现100%体制分类准确率（分岔前后语境r̂差异0.659）。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明符号学理论（皮尔斯框架及其通过Silverstein、Derrida和突变理论的扩展）可以作为可微分神经计算操作化，产生能够意识到自身输出不可靠条件的架构。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供SRT作为概念验证，包含STANDARD和REFLEXIVE两种推理模式，使模型能够主动检测意义分歧和崩溃，提高在语义不稳定场景下的可靠性。

title: Detecting Tariff Effects on Consumer Prices in Real Time – Part II
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System,  and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Detecting Tariff Effects on Consumer Prices in Real Time – Part II

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Major changes in U.S. trade policy last year have led to a surge of interest in the timely assessment of the economic effects of tariffs. Minton and Somale (2025) developed a methodology to detect tariff effects on consumer prices in real time that relies solely on publicly available data.

AI.tldr: Minton和Somale（2025）开发了一种仅使用公开数据实时检测关税对消费者价格影响的方法论
AI.research_question: 如何利用公开数据实时评估关税对消费者价格的经济影响？
AI.motivation: 美国贸易政策的重大变化引发了对关税经济效应及时评估的迫切需求，需要开发实时监测方法
AI.theoretical_framework: 关税传导理论、价格传递机制、实时经济监测方法论
AI.method: 基于公开数据的实证分析方法，开发实时检测关税对消费者价格影响的方法论
AI.findings: 成功开发了仅依赖公开数据就能实时检测关税对消费者价格影响的方法
AI.theory_contributions: 为关税经济效应评估提供了新的实时监测理论框架和方法论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业和研究人员提供了实时评估关税影响的实用工具，仅需公开数据即可操作

title: Smart Traffic Violation Detection & Enforcement
affiliations: Koneru Lakshmaiah Education Foundation, Koneru Lakshmaiah Education Foundation, Koneru Lakshmaiah Education Foundation, Koneru Lakshmaiah Education Foundation and Koneru Lakshmaiah Education Foundation

detail.title: Smart Traffic Violation Detection & Enforcement
detail.abstract: In many regions, breaking traffic lawsparticularly failing to wear a helmet and failing to have a license plate-stays a main reason of injuries and untraceable offenses. This venture indicates an integrated deep gaining knowledge ofprimarily based device that uses the YOLOv8 item detection model at the side of optical character reputation (OCR) to detect helmet use and car license plates in actual time. In addition to processing stay surveillance photos, the device recognizes vehicle numbers, identifies motorcycle riders who aren't carrying helmets, and logs violation info in a database. Based on earlier offense records, registered automobile owners receive automatic first-class notifications. Even in one-of-a-kind lights and climate conditions, the model keeps a constant level of detection accuracy. This approach lessens the need for guide enforcement while growing the effectiveness of visitors monitoring.

AI.tldr: 基于YOLOv8目标检测模型与OCR技术，开发实时检测头盔佩戴和车辆牌照的系统，自动识别违规行为并发送罚单通知，提升交通监控效率。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度学习技术实时检测摩托车头盔佩戴情况和车辆牌照，并自动处理交通违规行为？
AI.motivation: 在许多地区，不戴头盔和无牌照是导致交通事故伤害和难以追踪违规行为的主要原因，需要自动化解决方案提高交通执法效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于计算机视觉的深度学习框架，结合目标检测（YOLOv8模型）和光学字符识别（OCR）技术，构建实时交通违规检测系统。
AI.method: 使用YOLOv8模型进行实时目标检测，识别头盔佩戴情况；结合OCR技术提取车辆牌照信息；建立数据库记录违规信息；基于历史数据自动发送罚单通知。
AI.findings: 系统在不同光照和天气条件下保持稳定的检测精度，能够实时识别未戴头盔的摩托车骑手和车辆牌照，自动记录违规信息并通知车主。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合目标检测和OCR的深度学习框架，为实时交通违规检测提供了新的技术解决方案，扩展了计算机视觉在交通管理中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了自动化交通监控系统，减少人工执法需求，提高执法效率；通过自动罚单通知机制，增强交通法规执行效果；系统适应不同环境条件，具有实际部署价值。

title: Reinforcement Learning and Trading on Noise in Limit Order Markets
affiliations: Nankai University, Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University (XJTLU) and Tianjin University - College of Management and Economics

detail.title: Reinforcement Learning and Trading on Noise in Limit Order Markets

declarations.funderStatement: Financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC) (No.72371184, 72141304, 72342022) and XJTLU RDF (21-02-023) is gratefully acknowledged.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces reinforcement learning to examine the effect of trading on noise in a dynamic limit order market equilibrium. It shows that intensive noise liquidity provision (consumption) increases speculators' liquidity consumption (provision), improving (reducing) market liquidity. Channeled by uninformed chasing and informed aggressive liquidity provision, the increasing noise liquidity provision and consumption, respectively, improve price efficiency, generating a U-shaped price efficiency to the noise trading uncertainty on liquidity provision and consumption. Associated with a hump-shaped (U-shaped) profitability for the informed (uninformed) at a U-shaped noise trading cost in the noise trading uncertainty, this implies that, at increasing noise trading cost, intensive noise liquidity provision improves market liquidity, price efficiency, order profitability of informed traders, and reduces the loss, even makes profit, for uninformed traders.

AI.tldr: 本文通过强化学习研究动态限价订单市场中噪声交易对市场流动性的影响，发现噪声流动性提供和消费的增强会改善市场流动性，并通过非知情追逐和知情激进流动性提供等渠道提升价格效率，形成U型价格效率曲线。
AI.research_question: 噪声交易如何影响动态限价订单市场的流动性、价格效率和交易者盈利能力？
AI.motivation: 理解噪声交易在动态市场均衡中的作用，特别是其对市场流动性、价格效率和不同交易者盈利能力的复杂影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 强化学习框架下的动态限价订单市场均衡理论，包含噪声交易者、知情交易者和非知情交易者的行为模型。
AI.method: 采用强化学习方法构建动态限价订单市场模型，分析噪声交易对市场均衡的影响机制。
AI.findings: 1) 噪声流动性提供增强会提高知情交易者的流动性消费，改善市场流动性；2) 通过非知情追逐和知情激进流动性提供渠道，噪声交易分别提升价格效率；3) 价格效率对噪声交易不确定性呈现U型关系；4) 知情交易者盈利呈驼峰型，非知情交易者盈利呈U型。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了噪声交易影响市场流动性的动态理论框架；2) 揭示了噪声交易通过不同渠道影响价格效率的机制；3) 提出了价格效率与噪声交易不确定性的U型关系理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为市场监管者理解噪声交易的市场影响提供依据；2) 帮助交易者制定基于噪声交易环境的策略；3) 为市场设计者优化流动性机制提供参考。

title: Fiscal Triggers and Debt-Aware Macroprudential Policy
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Universidad Pablo de Olavide and Federal University of Goias

detail.title: Fiscal Triggers and Debt-Aware Macroprudential Policy
detail.abstract: Should macroprudential policy respond to fiscal conditions and, if so, to which fiscal financial state variable? We study this question in a medium-scale DSGE model with heterogeneous households, banking frictions, and an occasionally binding housingcollateral constraint. In a benchmark architecture in which patient households are the residual holders of government bonds, fiscally contingent debt-aware macroprudential policy dampens leverage-driven amplification, lowers GDP-scaled present-value spending multipliers, and raises welfare.Our main result emerges in the sovereign–bank architecture, where banks hold sovereign bonds and fiscal deterioration affects private intermediation through bank sovereign exposure. In that environment, reacting to aggregate public debt is too coarse: it worsens collateral dynamics and lowers welfare. By contrast, a nexus-based rule conditioned on sovereign exposure relative to bank capital improves financial stabilization, mitigates collateral stress, lowers fiscal multipliers, and raises welfare. The main lesson is that debt awareness is not architecture-invariant: once sovereign risk is intermediated by banks, the relevant macroprudential target is the sovereign–bank nexus rather than aggregate public debt.

AI.tldr: 本文研究宏观审慎政策是否应响应财政状况，以及应针对何种财政金融状态变量。研究发现，在银行持有主权债券的架构下，基于主权银行关联（而非总公共债务）的宏观审慎规则能更有效稳定金融、降低财政乘数并提高福利。
AI.research_question: 宏观审慎政策是否应响应财政状况？如果是，应针对何种财政金融状态变量？
AI.motivation: 理解财政状况与宏观审慎政策之间的互动关系，特别是在不同金融架构下（如银行持有主权债券的情况），确定最有效的政策响应目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 中等规模DSGE模型，包含异质性家庭、银行摩擦和偶尔绑定的住房抵押约束；两种金融架构：基准架构（耐心家庭持有政府债券）和主权-银行架构（银行持有主权债券）。
AI.method: 使用中等规模动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型进行分析，模型包含异质性家庭、银行摩擦和偶尔绑定的住房抵押约束，比较不同金融架构下的政策效果。
AI.findings:
1. 在基准架构下，财政敏感的债务感知宏观审慎政策能抑制杠杆驱动放大、降低GDP规模现值支出乘数并提高福利。
2. 在主权-银行架构下，对总公共债务做出反应的政策过于粗糙，会恶化抵押品动态并降低福利。
3. 基于主权银行关联（主权暴露相对于银行资本）的规则能改善金融稳定、缓解抵押品压力、降低财政乘数并提高福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出债务感知并非架构不变的观点：一旦主权风险由银行中介，相关的宏观审慎目标应是主权-银行关联而非总公共债务。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体指导：在银行持有主权债券的金融体系中，宏观审慎政策应针对主权银行关联（银行主权暴露相对于资本）而非简单的总公共债务水平。

title: Progressive Frequency aware Transformer for Lightweight Single Image Super Resolution
affiliations: Xi'an University of Technology, Xi'an University of Technology, Xi'an University of Technology, Xi'an University of Technology and Xi'an University of Technology

detail.title: Progressive Frequency aware Transformer for Lightweight Single Image Super Resolution
detail.abstract: Single-image super-resolution aims to recover high-quality details from low-resolution inputs. Existing window-based Transformer methods usually allocate similar computation to smooth and texture-rich regions, limiting fine-detail reconstruction under a small model budget. To address this issue, we propose the Progressive Frequency Aware Transformer network (PFAT), a lightweight Transformer that allocates computation according to frequency characteristics and local texture complexity. PFAT contains two key components. The Progressive Gated Cumulative Control module (PGCC) combines local cues, global priors, and a band-pass frequency mask, and accumulates gate responses across layers using a Hadamard product and an exponential moving average. This design enhances edges and textures while suppressing smooth backgrounds and noise. The adaptive multi-scale star feed-forward network (AMSFFN) employs parallel depth-wise convolutions (DWConv) with different kernel sizes to capture both local details and broader context, improving the discrimination between low-frequency structures and high-frequency details. Experiments on standard benchmark datasets show that PFAT, with about 750 K parameters, achieves competitive or superior reconstruction performance compared with recent lightweight super-resolution methods while maintaining favorable efficiency.

AI.tldr: PFAT是一种轻量级Transformer网络，通过渐进式频率感知机制，根据图像区域的频率特性和纹理复杂度动态分配计算资源，在约75万参数下实现了与现有轻量级超分辨率方法相当或更优的重建性能。
AI.research_question: 如何在有限的模型预算下，通过自适应计算分配策略，提升单图像超分辨率中细节纹理的重建质量？
AI.motivation: 现有基于窗口的Transformer方法通常对平滑区域和纹理丰富区域分配相似的计算资源，这在小型模型预算下限制了精细细节的重建能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 渐进式频率感知机制：根据图像区域的频率特性和局部纹理复杂度动态分配计算资源；2) 门控累积控制：结合局部线索、全局先验和带通频率掩码；3) 自适应多尺度特征提取：通过不同核大小的深度卷积捕获局部细节和更广泛的上下文信息。
AI.method: 提出PFAT网络，包含两个关键组件：1) 渐进式门控累积控制模块(PGCC)：使用Hadamard乘积和指数移动平均在层间累积门响应，增强边缘和纹理同时抑制平滑背景和噪声；2) 自适应多尺度星型前馈网络(AMSFFN)：采用不同核大小的并行深度卷积，同时捕获局部细节和更广泛的上下文，改善低频结构和高频细节的区分。
AI.findings: 在标准基准数据集上的实验表明，PFAT（约75万参数）相比近期轻量级超分辨率方法，实现了竞争性或更优的重建性能，同时保持了良好的计算效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了基于频率感知的计算分配理论框架；2) 发展了渐进式门控累积机制；3) 建立了自适应多尺度特征提取的理论基础，为轻量级超分辨率模型设计提供了新的理论方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 开发了参数效率高的轻量级超分辨率模型（约75万参数）；2) 实现了在有限计算资源下的高质量图像重建；3) 为移动设备和边缘计算场景提供了实用的超分辨率解决方案；4) 代码和模型可供研究社区使用。

title: The Regime-Inversion Theorem: Geometric Detection of Market Crisis via Toroidal Manifold Analysis
affiliations: Axiom Corp Ltd

detail.title: The Regime-Inversion Theorem: Geometric Detection of Market Crisis via Toroidal Manifold Analysis

declarations.funderStatement: Independent research – no external funding

detail.abstract: We present the Regime-Inversion Theorem, an empirical finding arising from the application of Cadar Chain Monte Carlo (CCMC) sampling on toroidal manifolds to financial time series data. The theorem states that the fraction of S&P 500 index constituents exhibiting negative toroidal curvature (denoted Ω(t)) provides a reliable, real-time, parameter-free detector of market regime requiring no external economic indicators. Across nine historically distinct market windows spanning 2015 to 2026 (7,100+ validated experiments), we observe perfect three-tier classification: systemic crisis regimes produce Ω > 60%, true stable regimes produce Ω < 20%, and a post-2020 elevated gray zone persists at Ω ≈ 40%. Trans-crisis analysis of 79 reference symbols demonstrates that 66 (83.5%) undergo statistically significant geometric sign inversion between crisis and stable windows (binomial p = 1.2 × 10⁻⁹, Cohen's h = 0.73, large effect). The 2026 Iran war / Brent oil shock (Ω = 82.1%) was detected in real time without access to news feeds, VIX, credit spreads, or macroeconomic data. We further identify a permanent post-COVID DC bias shift in the market manifold (+23 percentage points), analogous to ferromagnetic hysteresis, suggesting that the equilibrium geometry of equity markets is non-stationary across crisis events of sufficient magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"制度反转定理"，发现标普500成分股的负环面曲率分数Ω(t)可作为无参数、实时的市场制度检测器，无需外部经济指标。研究发现Ω>60%为系统性危机，Ω<20%为稳定制度，2020年后存在Ω≈40%的灰色区域。2026年伊朗战争/布伦特原油冲击被实时检测到，并发现COVID后市场流形存在永久性直流偏置偏移。
AI.research_question: 标普500指数成分股的负环面曲率分数Ω(t)能否作为无参数、实时的市场制度检测器？市场流形的几何特性在不同危机事件中是否具有非平稳性？
AI.motivation: 传统市场制度检测方法依赖外部经济指标、新闻数据或复杂参数模型，缺乏实时、参数无关的检测工具。需要开发基于市场内在几何特性的检测方法，以提供更纯粹的市场状态信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环面流形几何理论、Cadar Chain Monte Carlo (CCMC)采样方法、金融时间序列的几何表示、市场流形的曲率分析、制度反转定理
AI.method: 应用Cadar Chain Monte Carlo (CCMC)采样在环面流形上分析金融时间序列数据。研究覆盖2015-2026年9个历史市场窗口，进行7,100+验证实验。分析79个参考符号的跨危机几何符号反转，使用二项检验和Cohen's h效应量统计。
AI.findings: 1. Ω(t)提供完美的三层分类：Ω>60%为系统性危机制度，Ω<20%为稳定制度，Ω≈40%为2020年后持续的灰色区域；2. 83.5%的符号在危机与稳定窗口间经历统计显著的几何符号反转；3. 2026年伊朗战争/布伦特原油冲击(Ω=82.1%)被实时检测；4. COVID后市场流形存在+23个百分点的永久性直流偏置偏移，类似铁磁滞现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"制度反转定理"作为市场制度检测的新理论框架；2. 证明市场流形几何特性可作为无参数检测工具；3. 发现市场均衡几何在足够规模的危机事件中具有非平稳性；4. 建立市场流形曲率与制度状态的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供实时、参数无关的市场制度检测工具；2. 无需外部经济指标或新闻数据；3. 可用于系统性风险监测和危机预警；4. 为投资组合管理和风险控制提供新的几何视角。

title: The Q1 2026 Balance Sheet Stress Report: A Three-Regime Classification of S&P 500 Non-Financial Equity Structures

detail.title: The Q1 2026 Balance Sheet Stress Report: A Three-Regime Classification of S&P 500 Non-Financial Equity Structures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests. This research was produced independently by TheFinSense without external funding, grant support, consulting relationships, or paid commissions. The author holds no undisclosed equity, debt, or derivative positions in any of the 27 firms named in the Regime 3 cohort, nor in any S&P 500 constituent referenced as a counter-example. No firm, fund, or financial institution reviewed, edited, or influenced the content or conclusions of this study prior to publication.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involves no human subjects, no patient data, and no private or protected information. All data are drawn from publicly available SEC EDGAR XBRL filings and FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data) CSV endpoints in the public domain. No IRB approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All data acquisition, analysis, and production costs were borne by TheFinSense (Independent Research).

detail.abstract: This study analyzes the most recent 10-Q or 10-K filings of 396 S&P 500 non-financial constituents (97% coverage) and finds that 27 firms (6.8%) report negative stockholders' equity — a Regime 3 condition where the classical debt-to-equity ratio is mathematically undefined. The Regime 3 cohort is not uniformly distressed: Consumer Discretionary alone contributes 11 of 27 firms (41%) primarily through aggressive share buybacks in franchise and asset-light operating models, whereas HCA Healthcare's 5-year equity trajectory (−$0.93B FY2021 → −$6.03B FY2025) exemplifies genuine leverage buildup. The study proposes a three-regime framework (Normal, Thin, Broken) and applies Cathcart, Dufour, Rossi, and Varotto (2020)'s 1.24-percentage-point large-firm annual default-probability gap across leverage quartiles — the correct benchmark for S&P 500 application, in contrast to the 2.87 pp SME figure frequently misattributed. Data sources include SEC EDGAR XBRL and FRED (2021-2026). The macro backdrop of a +275 bps 10-year Treasury shift accompanied by a 30 bps BAA credit-spread compression is shown to be consistent with investment-grade maturity management.

AI.tldr: 研究发现标普500非金融成分股中有6.8%公司股东权益为负值，提出三区制框架分析，并应用大企业违约概率基准评估风险

title: Yoshika: A Python Package for Pharmacokinetic-Pharmacodynamic Simulation of Local Anesthetics with Selectable Initial Compartment
affiliations: Shiga University

detail.title: Yoshika: A Python Package for Pharmacokinetic-Pharmacodynamic Simulation of Local Anesthetics with Selectable Initial Compartment
detail.abstract: yoshika (Yielding Open Simulation of Hybrid Inter-disciplinary Kinetic Absorption) is an open-source Python package for pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic (PKPD) simulation of local anesthetics with a selectable initial compartment. Traditional three-compartment pharmacokinetic models assume intravenous administration where drug enters the central plasma compartment first. In regional anesthesia, however, drug is deposited directly into tissues: a successful peripheral nerve block deposits drug into vessel-poor tissue, while a failed block may deposit drug into vessel-rich tissue or directly into plasma. yoshika enables researchers and clinicians to simulate these clinically distinct scenarios by selecting the initial compartment of drug deposition and comparing the resulting concentration-time profiles and pharmacodynamic effects. The package includes built-in parameters for four local anesthetics (lidocaine, bupivacaine, ropivacaine, levobupivacaine), an effect-site compartment with sigmoid Emax pharmacodynamic model, and visualization utilities. By quantifying how the initial compartment determines peak plasma concentration and time-to-toxicity, yoshika supports the concept of context-sensitive maximum dose recommendations and route-adaptive PKPD simulation in anesthesia information management systems.

AI.tldr: yoshika是一个开源Python包，用于局部麻醉药的药代动力学-药效学模拟，可选择初始给药隔室，支持区域麻醉中不同临床场景的模拟。

AI.findings: yoshika能够量化初始给药隔室如何决定血浆峰值浓度和中毒时间，支持情境敏感性最大剂量推荐的概念。

AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和临床医生提供开源模拟工具，支持麻醉信息管理系统中路线自适应的PKPD模拟，有助于优化局部麻醉给药方案和安全性评估。

title: Compression: A Complete Mathematical Treatment
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title: Compression: A Complete Mathematical Treatment
detail.abstract: Compression is among the most productive organizing ideas in mathematics, statistics, and computer science. At the operational level it is the task of representing data with fewer bits while preserving either exact recoverability or acceptable fidelity. At the conceptual level it is a theory of exploitable structure: data are compressible precisely when they contain regularity, and the limit of compressibility is entropy. This paper develops a mathematically complete and unified treatment of compression. Classical foundations-Shannon entropy, Huffman coding, arithmetic coding, Lempel-Ziv universality, rate-distortion theory, transform coding, vector quantization, MDL, and Kolmogorov complexity-are treated with full proofs. New material includes: polar codes and source polarization; network information theory covering Slepian-Wolf, Wyner-Ziv, and the CEO problem; finite-length bounds via the normal approximation and channel dispersion; deep quantization theory including companding, Bennett's integral, lattice quantizers, and Zador's formula; algorithmic statistics and sufficient statistics; Bregman divergences and information geometry; LLMs as universal compressors with Bayesian in-context learning, Chinchilla scaling laws, and KV cache compression via QJL, PolarQuant, and TurboQuant; and applications to quantitative finance covering factor models, MDL model selection, LZ complexity as a market predictability index, and information-geometric portfolio theory. Throughout, the exposition maximizes mathematical rigor with complete or detailed-sketch proofs.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提供了一个关于压缩理论的数学完整统一处理，涵盖了从经典基础（香农熵、霍夫曼编码等）到前沿主题（极性码、网络信息论、深度学习量化、LLM作为通用压缩器、金融应用）的全面内容。

AI.theoretical_framework: 信息论、编码理论、算法信息论（Kolmogorov复杂度）、统计学习理论、信息几何、深度学习理论。

AI.findings: 论文系统性地建立了压缩理论的统一数学框架，展示了从经典编码到现代应用（如LLM压缩、金融模型）的完整理论体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了压缩理论的数学完整统一处理；2. 整合了经典基础与现代发展；3. 建立了从信息论到深度学习的理论连接；4. 发展了信息几何在压缩中的应用。

title: Impact-Induced Internal Crack Propagation in Beam-Column Joints Based on Nonlinear Multiphysics Simulation Analysis
affiliations: Kunming University of Science and Technology, Kunming University of Science and Technology, Kunming University of Science and Technology and State Grid Electric Power Engineering Research Institute (Beijing)

detail.title: Impact-Induced Internal Crack Propagation in Beam-Column Joints Based on Nonlinear Multiphysics Simulation Analysis
detail.abstract: Within the field of civil engineering, concrete beams and columns, owing to the non-homogeneity of their internal structure, are prone to crack initiation and propagation under sustained external loading. The formation of such cracks significantly alters the material's mechanical properties, accelerating failure. This manifests as a progressive decline in structural load-bearing capacity, degradation of stiffness, and reduced overall stability, potentially culminating in catastrophic failure. Therefore, this paper employs the moving focus dispersion line method alongside a multi-physics coupling simulation software based on advanced nonlinear finite element technology. Six sets of test conditions were conducted on precast concrete beam-column impact models, varying both the location and quantity of cracks.. Results indicate significant fluctuations in crack propagation velocity within single-crack specimens. For instance, Specimen T1 exhibited a peak Lu crack velocity of 188.5 m/s, while Specimen Ld recorded an initial peak velocity of 315.7 m/s post-crack initiation, with a secondary peak velocity reaching 391.8 m/s. In specimen T2, the Zl crack exhibited a peak velocity of 247.5 m/s, while the Zr crack reached an initial peak velocity of 189.9 m/s and a secondary peak velocity of 305 m/s. In the specimen with dual internal cracks (T3), crack propagation exhibited significant mutual influence. Crack Ld reached an initial peak velocity of 336.5 m/s before crack Zr initiated. Following Zr initiation, its velocity gradually increased, attaining a secondary peak velocity of 300.5 m/s at 1460 µs. Compared to single-crack specimens, both the initial and secondary peak velocities of the columnar crack in the dual-crack specimen occurred approximately 1000 µs earlier, reflecting crack-to-crack interaction. Within multi-crack systems, numerical simulations revealed continuous, progressive variations in crack propagation velocity without distinct demarcation lines. For instance, in specimen S3 where vertical and transverse cracks coexisted, the velocity variation curve exhibited a more gradual slope. The simulations further elucidated the dynamic evolution of stress fields at crack tips, providing robust support for understanding multi-crack interaction mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文采用移动焦点色散线法和基于先进非线性有限元技术的多物理场耦合仿真软件，研究了预制混凝土梁柱冲击模型中裂纹位置和数量对裂纹扩展行为的影响。研究发现单裂纹试件裂纹扩展速度波动显著，双裂纹试件中裂纹间存在明显相互作用，多裂纹系统中裂纹扩展速度呈现连续渐进变化。
AI.research_question: 不同位置和数量的裂纹如何影响预制混凝土梁柱冲击模型中的裂纹扩展行为？
AI.motivation: 混凝土梁柱内部结构非均匀性使其在持续外部荷载下容易产生裂纹萌生和扩展，这些裂纹会显著改变材料力学性能，加速结构失效，表现为承载能力下降、刚度退化和整体稳定性降低，可能导致灾难性破坏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于非线性有限元技术的多物理场耦合理论，移动焦点色散线方法，裂纹动力学理论。
AI.method: 采用移动焦点色散线法结合基于先进非线性有限元技术的多物理场耦合仿真软件，对预制混凝土梁柱冲击模型进行了六组不同裂纹位置和数量的试验条件模拟。
AI.findings:
1. 单裂纹试件裂纹扩展速度波动显著：T1试件Lu裂纹峰值速度188.5 m/s，Ld裂纹初始峰值315.7 m/s，二次峰值391.8 m/s；T2试件Zl裂纹峰值247.5 m/s，Zr裂纹初始峰值189.9 m/s，二次峰值305 m/s。
2. 双裂纹试件裂纹间存在明显相互作用：T3试件中Ld裂纹在Zr裂纹萌生前达到初始峰值336.5 m/s，Zr裂纹萌生后速度逐渐增加，在1460 μs达到二次峰值300.5 m/s。与单裂纹试件相比，双裂纹试件中柱状裂纹的初始和二次峰值速度均提前约1000 μs。
3. 多裂纹系统中裂纹扩展速度呈现连续渐进变化：S3试件中垂直和横向裂纹共存时，速度变化曲线斜率更平缓。
4. 数值模拟揭示了裂纹尖端应力场的动态演化过程。
AI.theory_contributions:

title: EU Funds for the Socio-Ecological Transition: Lessons from the MFF 2021-2027
affiliations: University of Padua, European Social Observatory (OSE), Independent, University of Antwerp and University of Milan

detail.title: EU Funds for the Socio-Ecological Transition: Lessons from the MFF 2021-2027

publicationDetails.journalName: European Trade Union Institute (ETUI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This research examines the extent to which the European Union’s 2021–2027 Multiannual Financial Framework (MFF) has supported eco-social policies – defined as public policies explicitly pursuing both environmental and social policy goals in an integrated manner – across Member States. Through documentary analysis of fund regulations and case studies of Bulgaria and Italy, five major funding instruments are analysed: the Just Transition Fund (JTF), the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF), the European Social Fund Plus (ESF+), the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF) and the Cohesion Fund. 

Our findings reveal significant variation in eco-social potential across instruments. Only the JTF explicitly earmarks resources for just transition policies, supporting measures from skills development to energy efficiency improvements in social housing. The ESF+ allocates resources to green skills and jobs, with considerable cross-national variation. The ERDF and the Cohesion Fund contribute primarily indirectly through energy efficiency investments in social infrastructure and housing and skills development linked to smart specialisation strategies. 

Critical implementation gaps emerge. There is structural asymmetry: activation-oriented measures – training, reskilling, employability support – dominate, while redistributive and protective instruments addressing income loss, job displacement or transition-related social risks remain only weakly developed. Administrative capacity, political stability and governance quality function as decisive mediating factors. Policy integration across funds remains uneven and depends on deliberate cross-fund coordination mechanisms, sufficient administrative capacity and stable governance arrangements. Stakeholder involvement, although procedurally mandated, has proved to be substantially limited; consultations tend to occur late in programming cycles and exert little influence over strategic choices. 

The research concludes that while there are institutional frameworks for eco-social policy within the current MFF, their operationalisation is driven by a social investment logic that prioritises workforce adaptation over welfare compensation. Recommendations for the post-2027 MFF include: conduct comprehensive eco-social policy stocktaking; earmark adequate resources for just transition; strengthen administrative capacity; establish dedicated eco-social transition benefits; and explore earmarked funding for national welfare state reforms aligned with green transition objectives.

title: Tesla Versus National Models: Union Organising and Union Busting in Sweden, Germany and the United States
affiliations: Independent, Cornell University - School of Industrial and Labor Relations, Cornell University and Independent

detail.title: Tesla Versus National Models: Union Organising and Union Busting in Sweden, Germany and the United States

publicationDetails.journalName: European Trade Union Institute (ETUI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This report examines Tesla’s labour relations practices in Sweden, Germany and the United States, analysing how the company has systematically resisted trade union recognition and collective bargaining in three distinct national industrial relations contexts. Drawing on original research, the authors document the firm’s union-busting strategies and tactics — including a refusal to sign collective bargaining agreements, flooding works councils with anti union candidates, deploying strikebreakers and exploiting legal loopholes — as well as the responses of unions in the three countries. 

The report situates Tesla’s behaviour within the context of broader workforce fragmentation and management practices: a young, relatively low-skilled and disproportionately migrant workforce; opaque pay structures and processes; hazardous working conditions; and unilateral managerialism. These grievances have driven organising efforts while also complicating union strategies. Elon Musk's opposition to collective representation is shown to be not merely rhetorical but embedded in management philosophy and operational practice. 

The authors argue that Tesla represents a strategic threat beyond the auto sector: as a first mover in the battery electric vehicle market, the company may also be a first mover in normalising employer practices that undermine established European norms applying to industrial relations institutions. The report concludes with recommendations for trade unions in Europe on how to coordinate responses to transnational union-busting.
