title: Intelligent Document Processing and Machine Learning in Non-QM Mortgage Origination: Income Pattern Extraction and Fraud Detection for Self-Employed Borrower Populations

detail.title: Intelligent Document Processing and Machine Learning in Non-QM Mortgage Origination: Income Pattern Extraction and Fraud Detection for Self-Employed Borrower Populations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived to influence the work presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or any personally identifiable information. Therefore, ethics approval or informed consent was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Non-qualified mortgage lending in the United States has achieved a record share of total origination volume in mid-2025, driven primarily by bank statement loan programs serving self-employed borrowers whose income characteristics are incompatible with conventional documentation requirements. The expansion of this market has made efficient and reliable bank statement income analysis a critical operational capability, one that manual review processes cannot provide at scale. This paper examines the technical mechanisms through which intelligent document processing and machine learning address the income analysis problem in non-QM origination. The analysis proceeds through three functional layers: document extraction, in which optical character recognition and natural language processing convert unstructured bank statement documents into structured transaction data; income pattern recognition, in which time-series modeling and classification algorithms construct cash flow profiles from the extracted data; and anomaly detection, in which statistical deviation analysis and document forensics identify fraud indicators and economic inconsistencies. The paper reviews published evidence from lender deployments including Angel Oak Mortgage Solutions, Sierra Pacific Mortgage, and Better Home Finance, documenting productivity gains of four to four-and-a-half times underwriting throughput, processing time reductions from hours to minutes, and reported improvements in fraud detection reliability. The analysis also addresses the conditions under which AI deployment in this context carries operational and compliance risk, with particular attention to training data composition, model explainability requirements under the Equal Credit Opportunity Act, and the appropriate scope of human oversight. The paper situates these findings within the broader trajectory of intelligent document processing as a market category

title: The Pursuit of Gender Equality in the Workplace and Trade Unions in Europe: Progress, Challenges and Potential
affiliations: European Trade Union Institute (ETUI), European Trade Union Institute (ETUI), European Trade Union Institute (ETUI) and European Trade Union Institute (ETUI)

detail.title: The Pursuit of Gender Equality in the Workplace and Trade Unions in Europe: Progress, Challenges and Potential

publicationDetails.journalName: European Trade Union Institute (ETUI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
As European labour markets have become more feminised, so has the union membership base. This report reviews the literature to provide an overview of how trade unions in Europe are engaging with and driving gender equality before then reviewing both secondary data and original empirical material to assess progress. A distinction is made between unions’ internal equality efforts and those aimed externally; that is, at the wider world of work. This exploration of how union initiatives are advancing is also framed with a continuum of equality approaches and the dimensions of a recently-developed organisational or institutional-level equality index. 

Based on quantitative analysis of existing collective bargaining and gender pay gap (GPG) data, and a thematic assessment of survey and detailed interview evidence, it emerges that unions expend considerable effort in seeking to improve gender equality. Internally, substantial progress has been made in terms of feminising mainstream structures and activities, and with establishing equality structures and posts to help ensure the representation of diverse perspectives. Externally, unions have also advanced equality through their engagement in a wide array of workplace topics, with key successes concerning pay transparency and work-life balance. Secondary analysis also evidences that collective bargaining coverage is clearly associated with reduced GPGs, and that the impact is generally stronger in countries where unions are more feminised. The qualitative aspects of the research also highlight key areas of linkage between internal and external equality through which more inclusive organisations see greater attention afforded to gender equality in the workplace. 

Despite the strides that have been made, the analysis also reveals sizeable variations between countries in terms of attitudes towards gender equality. This also permeates trade unions as entities influenced by their surroundings. Moreover, the fragility of the equality gains that have been made is underscored, particularly due to limitations on resources amid an uncertain and increasingly hostile environment, leading many respondents and interviewees to highlight the need to defend progress to date. Contextual variation is also stressed, with demands on limited union resources hitting smaller organisations harder. These findings develop the dimensions of the equality index, indicating the specificity of unions’ goals, processes and structures vis-à-vis other forms of organisation. The report concludes by discussing the implications of the key findings for, and the use of the index in the formulation of, union equality strategy, policy and practice.

title: DEI Training and Title VII
affiliations: Vanderbilt University - Law School

detail.title: DEI Training and Title VII

publicationDetails.detailsText: Denver Law Review, Vol. 102, No. 2, forthcoming 2026

detail.abstract:
Diversity initiatives of any kind are now under attack, as the Trump Administration has upended courts’ interpretation of discrimination, rescinded EO 11246, and threatened cancellation of or actually canceled the federal contracts of businesses and universities that even mention DEI initiatives.

In Young v. Colorado Department of Corrections, the plaintiff alleged that the department’s DEI employee training subjected him to a racially hostile work environment in violation of Title VII. In upholding the district court’s decision to dismiss Young’s case, the Tenth Circuit held that the DEI training did not subject Young to harassment that was sufficiently “severe or pervasive” to establish a racially hostile work environment as required under Title VII, nor did Young establish that he suffered harassing treatment from coworkers that met this standard. However, the court left open the possibility that DEI training that used race-based rhetoric could meet the standard for harassment under Title VII, saying that “[i]f not already at the destination, this type of race-based rhetoric is well on the way to arriving at objectively and subjectively harassing messaging.” Further, the Tenth Circuit postulated that DEI training “could promote racial discrimination and stereotypes within the workplace” and “encourage racial preferences in hiring, firing, and promotion decisions.”

Courts to date, including the Tenth Circuit, have not found DEI training to be discriminatory. Although the Tenth Circuit went further than other courts in suggesting that DEI training could itself promote employment discrimination, it only speculated—without providing support for—this possibility. By examining the legal environment governing workplace harassment and social science research on the reach and impact of DEI training on employment outcomes, this Article concludes that, for now, it is unlikely that DEI training will be found to be unlawful employment discrimination.

AI.tldr: 本文分析DEI培训是否构成非法就业歧视的法律问题。尽管特朗普政府攻击多样性倡议，法院迄今未认定DEI培训本身构成歧视，但第十巡回法院暗示某些种族言论可能达到骚扰标准。文章结合法律环境和社会科学研究，认为目前DEI培训不太可能被认定为非法就业歧视。
AI.research_question: DEI培训是否构成非法就业歧视？
AI.motivation: 特朗普政府攻击多样性倡议，取消相关行政命令，威胁取消提及DEI的企业和大学联邦合同。同时，法院案件如Young v. Colorado Department of Corrections引发DEI培训是否构成就业歧视的法律争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Title VII就业歧视法理论，特别是关于"严重或普遍"骚扰标准的法律框架，以及社会心理学关于DEI培训效果的研究。
AI.method: 法律环境分析（包括法院判例、行政命令变化）和社会科学研究综述（DEI培训对就业结果的影响研究）。
AI.findings: 1. 法院迄今未认定DEI培训构成歧视；2. 第十巡回法院虽暗示某些种族言论可能达到骚扰标准，但仅为推测；3. 结合法律和社会科学研究，目前DEI培训不太可能被认定为非法就业歧视。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清DEI培训在Title VII下的法律地位，区分培训内容与歧视行为的界限，为多样性倡议的法律保护提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供DEI培训合法性的法律指导，帮助组织设计符合法律要求的多样性培训项目，减少法律风险。

title: Tokenization and the Legal Architecture of Finance
affiliations: University of Zurich

detail.title: Tokenization and the Legal Architecture of Finance

publicationDetails.detailsText: Stanford Journal of Blockchain Law & Policy (forthcoming)

detail.abstract:
The tokenization of finance has entered a phase of institutional adoption, and it does not merely modernize existing market mechanisms but constitutes a structural expansion of finance itself. By enabling fractionalization, broader access, continuous trading, and scalable liquidity, tokenization transforms assets and activities previously situated outside financial markets into objects of financial exchange, thereby extending the reach of finance to domains as diverse as real estate, intellectual property, prediction markets, and digital gaming environments. 

On this basis, this Article shows that this expansion requires rethinking financial law as a foundational regulatory layer intersecting with property, contract, commercial, central banking, and consumer law. If left unaddressed, tokenization intensifies speculative dynamics, accelerates market contagion, and exposes individuals to financial risk through products that resemble everyday digital services rather than traditional investments. Existing legal categories struggle to capture these dynamics, creating regulatory gaps that threaten investor protection and systemic stability. 

This Article suggests that effective governance requires a dual approach: financial law must address risks arising from scale, liquidity, and marketization, while private-law regimes continue to govern underlying assets and legal relationships. Tokenization represents a durable transformation of the financial system, demanding adaptive regulation and renewed attention to financial and technological literacy.

AI.tldr: 金融代币化不仅是市场机制的现代化，更是金融体系的结构性扩张，将房地产、知识产权、预测市场等非传统资产转化为金融交易对象，需要重新思考金融法作为基础监管层的作用。
AI.research_question: 金融代币化如何扩展金融体系的范围，以及这种扩展对金融法律框架提出了哪些新的监管挑战？
AI.motivation: 金融代币化已进入机构采用阶段，它不仅现代化现有市场机制，更是金融本身的结构性扩张，将传统上处于金融市场之外的资产和活动转化为金融交易对象，这带来了新的监管挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融扩张理论、监管框架理论、法律分类理论、系统性风险理论
AI.method: 理论分析、法律框架分析、监管差距识别、风险分析
AI.findings: 代币化通过资产分割化、更广泛的可及性、连续交易和可扩展流动性，将房地产、知识产权、预测市场和数字游戏环境等多样化领域纳入金融体系，现有法律类别难以捕捉这些动态，导致监管空白威胁投资者保护和系统稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了金融代币化作为金融体系结构性扩张的理论框架，识别了金融法与财产法、合同法、商法、中央银行法和消费者法交叉的基础监管层需求，发展了适应金融技术变革的监管理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议采用双重监管方法：金融法解决规模、流动性和市场化带来的风险，私法制度继续管理基础资产和法律关系；强调需要适应性监管和加强金融与技术素养教育。

title: Von's Grocery: Why Protecting 'Worthy Men' Was Anti-Consumer & Anti-Women
affiliations: Pepperdine University - Rick J. Caruso School of Law

detail.title: Von's Grocery: Why Protecting 'Worthy Men' Was Anti-Consumer & Anti-Women
detail.abstract:
In 1966, the Supreme Court granted an injunction against a proposed grocery store merger between Von’s Grocery Company and Shopping Bag Corporation, citing the merger’s potential anti-competitive effects.  Even in a questionably defined market, the post-merged company would have at most 7.5% of the Los Angeles grocery-store market—a share so small that inference of problematic market power was more conjecture than possibility. But the protection of consumers from a powerful merged-company was not the Court’s objective.  Rather, the majority in United States v. Von’s Grocery applied populist views of the day to protect “small dealers and worthy men.”  By putting a thumb on the scale in favor of Von’s Grocery’s business rivals, the Court simultaneously dismissed and overruled the interests of the key population of consumers, women.

The populist view that motivated the Von’s Grocery decision has had a recent resurgence at both the federal and state antitrust rulemakings and legislation.  This populist view, sometimes called the neo-Brandeisian view or progressive view of antitrust, stresses that antitrust should focus on a host of ill-defined concerns other than what is best for consumers. These advocates praise and have enshrined in U.S. merger law three of four famous merger cases from the 1960s that focused not on benefits to consumers but rather on benefits to special interests.  The fourth case, Von’s Grocery, is arguably the clearest articulation of the neo-Brandeisian view in practice but is not cited because it also serves as a condemnation of that viewpoint.

This paper analyzes the historic backdrop of the Von’s Grocery decision. Justice Stewart, in his dissent, noted that at the time of the proposed merger there was a “supermarket revolution” underway.  That statement, though true, was only the tip of the iceberg.  This paper explores both the supply-side, food distribution innovations—changes in refrigeration, frozen food technology, and centralized supermarkets-–and the shift in grocery store consumer demand—automobile ownership impacts, women entering the workplace, consumer refrigerator purchases, and women’s preferences for one-stop convenience. The seismic shifts in consumer demand and food supply that drove the supermarket revolution toward “bigness” had already occurred when the Court decided Von’s Grocery.  The paper concludes that by taking the focus off consumers, by not applying a consumer welfare standard, and instead choosing to protect “worthy men,” the Court missed the revolution. The result is that the Court unnecessarily hindered the maximization of benefits to grocery store consumers—and those consumers, by and large, were women.

AI.tldr: 本文分析1966年美国最高法院在United States v. Von's Grocery案中的判决，指出法院基于民粹主义观点阻止两家杂货店合并（合并后市场份额仅7.5%），旨在保护"小商人和值得尊敬的人"而非消费者利益。文章探讨该判决的历史背景，揭示当时正处于"超市革命"时期，法院忽视消费者需求变化（特别是女性消费者偏好），错误地将反垄断法用于保护特殊利益而非消费者福利。
AI.research_question: Von's Grocery案判决如何反映了反垄断法中的民粹主义观点，以及该判决如何忽视了当时正在发生的"超市革命"对消费者（特别是女性消费者）的影响？
AI.motivation: 近年来，被称为新布兰代斯主义或进步主义反垄断观的民粹主义观点在联邦和州层面的反垄断规则制定和立法中重新兴起。这种观点强调反垄断应关注一系列定义模糊的关切，而不仅仅是什么对消费者最有利。Von's Grocery案是这种观点在实践中最清晰的表述，但因其同时也构成了对该观点的谴责而未被引用。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 民粹主义反垄断理论（新布兰代斯主义/进步主义反垄断观）
2. 消费者福利标准理论
3. 反垄断法的经济效率理论
4. 市场结构与竞争理论
AI.method: 历史分析法：分析Von's Grocery案的历史背景，包括供给侧的食品分销创新（冷藏技术、冷冻食品技术、集中化超市）和杂货店消费者需求变化（汽车拥有率影响、女性进入职场、消费者冰箱购买、女性对一站式便利的偏好）。
AI.findings:
1. Von's Grocery案中，合并后公司市场份额最多仅7.5%，法院基于民粹主义观点阻止合并，旨在保护"小商人和值得尊敬的人"而非消费者
2. 法院判决时正值"超市革命"时期，供给侧和需求侧都发生了根本性变化
3. 法院将反垄断焦点从消费者转移，不适用消费者福利标准，而是选择保护特殊利益群体
4. 法院的判决不必要地阻碍了杂货店消费者（主要是女性）的利益最大化
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了民粹主义反垄断观在实践中的具体表现及其局限性
2. 提供了历史案例证明当反垄断法偏离消费者福利标准时可能产生的负面后果
3. 为当前反垄断政策辩论提供了历史视角，特别是关于新布兰代斯主义观点的讨论
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 警示政策制定者在反垄断决策中应坚持消费者福利标准
2. 强调反垄断执法应考虑市场实际变化和消费者需求
3. 为当前反垄断改革辩论提供历史教训，避免重复Von's Grocery案的错误
4. 提醒关注女性消费者在市场竞争中的特殊利益和需求

title: Quantitative forward guidance through interest rate projections
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements (BIS) - Monetary and Economic Department and Bank for International Settlements (BIS) - Monetary and Economic Department

detail.title: Quantitative forward guidance through interest rate projections
detail.abstract: We assess quantitative forward guidance provided through interest rate projections published by the Reserve Bank of New Zealand, the Norges Bank, the Swedish Riksbank and the Federal Reserve. We find that the interest rate projections help manage interest rate expectations. Market interest rates partially anticipate changes in the central bank projection path and adjust to path surprises, implying significant but incomplete predictability and credibility of the paths. We further find that the interest rate projections are not informationally redundant to central banks’ macroeconomic projections. They impact market rates even when controlling for inflation and real activity projections. Finally, interest rate projections and macroeconomic projections turn out to be consistent with an inflationstabilizing Taylor rule. The response of policy rates to inflation implied by the projections is significantly larger than one.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了新西兰、挪威、瑞典央行及美联储通过利率预测提供的量化前瞻指引，发现利率预测有助于管理利率预期，市场利率会部分预期央行预测路径变化并调整以应对意外，表明路径具有显著但不完全的预测性和可信度。利率预测与宏观经济预测信息不冗余，即使控制通胀和实际经济活动预测仍影响市场利率。利率预测与宏观经济预测符合通胀稳定型泰勒规则，政策利率对通胀的隐含反应显著大于1。
AI.research_question: 量化前瞻指引（通过央行利率预测）如何影响市场利率预期？利率预测与宏观经济预测的关系如何？这些预测是否符合通胀稳定型货币政策规则？
AI.motivation: 越来越多的央行开始发布利率预测作为前瞻指引工具，但缺乏对这些量化前瞻指引效果的实证评估。需要了解利率预测是否有效管理市场预期，以及它们与宏观经济预测的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 前瞻指引理论、预期管理理论、泰勒规则、信息冗余理论、市场有效性和信号传递理论。
AI.method: 实证分析，使用新西兰、挪威、瑞典央行及美联储的利率预测数据，分析市场利率对这些预测的反应，包括预期成分和意外成分的影响，并控制宏观经济预测变量。
AI.findings: 1. 利率预测有助于管理利率预期；2. 市场利率部分预期央行预测路径变化并调整应对意外，表明路径具有显著但不完全的预测性和可信度；3. 利率预测与宏观经济预测信息不冗余，即使控制通胀和实际经济活动预测仍影响市场利率；4. 利率预测与宏观经济预测符合通胀稳定型泰勒规则，政策利率对通胀的隐含反应显著大于1。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了量化前瞻指引效果的实证证据；2. 验证了利率预测作为独立信号的价值；3. 证实了央行预测与泰勒规则的一致性；4. 深化了对央行沟通策略有效性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行使用利率预测作为前瞻指引工具提供实证支持；2. 帮助央行了解市场对其预测的反应模式；3. 为央行改进沟通策略提供参考；4. 为投资者理解央行信号提供分析框架。

title: Risk Intelligence — A New Era for Institutional Finance
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Risk Intelligence — A New Era for Institutional Finance
detail.abstract: This paper presents a unified institutional risk intelligence framework combining Mandelbrot's Multifractal Model of Asset Returns (MMAR), LLM orchestration via Model Context Protocol (MCP), and a federated three-tier sovereign architecture for deployment at CCPs, custodians, SIFIs, pension funds, and regulators. The framework rests on three claims. First, Fractal Precision: Gaussian risk models systematically understate institutional tail risk — the ten-day VaR multiplier under empirically calibrated fractal dynamics (H=0.65) is 4.47, not the Gaussian sqrt(10) = 3.16, a 41% understatement embedded in every standard capital adequacy calculation. The framework provides fractal replacements for Market Risk VaR, Counterparty Credit Risk PFE and XVA, and Liquidity-at-Risk across all institutional asset classes. Second, Sovereign Architecture: a federated three-tier deployment model (Cloud SaaS, Federated PaaS, Full License) ensures data sovereignty at every tier, satisfies SR 11-7 model risk governance and DORA operational resilience requirements, and eliminates signal leakage risk through architectural isolation. Third, Regulatory Intelligence: an LLM layer above the deterministic fractal engine generates ICAAP and ILAAP supervisory narratives, FRTB and SA-CCR documentation, and real-time regime surveillance — creating a supervisory feedback flywheel of exceptional training quality for frontier AI systems. A no04/20/2026vel regulatory proposal — a Fractal Circuit Breaker providing proactive macro-prudential intervention based on coordinated CCP regime detection — is submitted for consideration by FSB, ESRB, FSOC, and BCBS. To the authors' knowledge as of April 2026, no prior published framework combines these four elements. This paper is the institutional companion to SSRN Abstract 6584378.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的机构风险智能框架，结合了Mandelbrot的多重分形资产回报模型、通过MCP协议的LLM编排，以及用于CCP、托管行、SIFIs、养老基金和监管机构部署的三层联邦主权架构。框架基于三个核心主张：分形精度显示高斯风险模型系统性低估尾部风险；主权架构确保数据主权和监管合规；监管智能层生成监管文档并实现实时监管监测。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的机构风险智能框架，能够准确捕捉尾部风险、确保数据主权合规，并提供监管智能功能？
AI.motivation: 传统高斯风险模型系统性低估机构尾部风险，现有风险框架缺乏数据主权保障和监管智能集成，需要开发一个结合分形理论、联邦架构和AI技术的综合解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. Mandelbrot多重分形资产回报模型(MMAR) - 用于准确建模尾部风险
2. 分形动力学理论 - 替代传统高斯假设
3. 联邦计算架构理论 - 确保数据主权和隔离
4. LLM编排理论 - 通过Model Context Protocol实现监管智能
AI.method:
1. 分形风险建模：使用H=0.65的分形动力学校准，计算VaR乘子
2. 三层联邦架构设计：云SaaS、联邦PaaS、完整许可证部署模式
3. LLM监管智能层：生成监管文档和实时监测
4. 实证校准：对比分形模型与高斯模型的风险度量差异
AI.findings:
1. 分形精度：10天VaR乘子在分形动力学下为4.47，而非高斯的3.16，存在41%的低估
2. 框架提供了市场风险VaR、交易对手信用风险PFE和XVA、流动性风险的全资产类别分形替代方案
3. 主权架构满足SR 11-7模型风险治理和DORA运营弹性要求
4. LLM层能生成ICAAP、ILAAP等监管叙事和文档
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次将分形理论、联邦架构和LLM智能整合到统一的风险框架中
2. 提出了分形风险度量对传统高斯模型的系统性修正
3. 发展了监管智能的反馈飞轮理论，为前沿AI系统提供高质量训练数据
4. 提出了"分形断路器"这一新的宏观审慎监管工具概念
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为CCP、托管行、SIFIs等机构提供可部署的风险管理解决方案
2. 满足数据主权要求和监管合规（SR 11-7、DORA等）
3. 自动化生成监管报告和文档，提高运营效率
4. 提出的分形断路器建议为FSB、ESRB等监管机构提供了新的政策工具

title: Forecasting Crude Oil Volatility in the Era of Geopolitical Shocks: A FinBERT-Enhanced Dual-Model Econometric Framework
affiliations: Independent, , , Independent, Independent and Independent

detail.title: Forecasting Crude Oil Volatility in the Era of Geopolitical Shocks: A FinBERT-Enhanced Dual-Model Econometric Framework
detail.abstract: Accurately forecasting which electric vehicle (EV) markets sustain growth momentum under geopolitical disruption is a critical challenge for infrastructure planners and policymakers. Dominant forecasting approaches—including IEA Global EV Outlook projections—failed to anticipate the 35% first-half 2024 German EV sales collapse triggered by the abrupt removal of the Umweltbonus subsidy in December 2023 (Zachmann, McWilliams and Tagliapietra, 2024; ACEA, 2024). This paper introduces a Decision-Aware Regime-Aware Machine Learning (DA-RAML) system that advances EV forecasting along four dimensions absent from the existing literature: binary resilience classification robust to distributional shift; a dual NLP sentiment pipeline integrating FinBERT-derived institutional news signals with VADER-based consumer review scores as forward-looking early-warning features; an integrated Hidden Markov Model – Gaussian Mixture Model (HMM-GMM) architecture for formal regime detection, wherein the GMM models continuous emission probabilities within each latent HMM state; and a decision-theoretic threshold calibration protocol that identifies 78% as the accuracy-maximising survival probability boundary under 2024 regime-shift conditions. Using an unbalanced panel dataset covering 50+ countries and 14 years (2011–2024), comprising 5,159 raw observations aggregated to 630 country-year records, we engineer a binary target of market resilience (any positive year-over-year growth under shock conditions). We evaluate four classifiers—Logistic Regression, Naïve Bayes, Random Forest, and Gradient Boosting—with hyperparameters tuned via 5-fold time-series cross-validation under a threescenario temporal validation protocol. The HMM-GMM system formally detects a statistically significant distributional shift between 2023 and 2024 market conditions (Bhattacharyya permutation test 𝑝 < 0.001), with 97% of 2024 observations assigned to the disrupted latent state versus only 56% in 2023. SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) analysis reveals that log(GDP_pc) contributes a larger mean absolute SHAP value (0.187) than Policy Score (0.094), a finding robust to feature correlation that directly challenges the policy-first investment thesis. We derive a Risk-Adjusted Resilience Index (RARI) and apply a calibrated 78% decision boundary as a capital allocation threshold, producing deployment recommendations across 31 markets. We explicitly address endogeneity concerns, pooled cross-section limitations, and KNN imputation leakage protocols.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个决策感知-制度感知机器学习系统(DA-RAML)，用于预测地缘政治冲击下电动汽车市场的增长持续性。该系统通过二元韧性分类、双NLP情感管道、HMM-GMM制度检测和决策理论阈值校准，在2024年德国EV销量暴跌35%的背景下，识别出78%为最优生存概率边界，挑战了政策优先的投资论点。
AI.research_question: 如何准确预测在地缘政治冲击下哪些电动汽车市场能够维持增长势头？
AI.motivation: 主流预测方法（包括IEA全球电动汽车展望）未能预测到2024年上半年德国电动汽车销量因环境补贴突然取消而暴跌35%。这暴露了现有预测方法在应对制度转变和分布变化方面的不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 决策感知机器学习；2) 制度感知建模；3) 韧性理论；4) 分布变化下的稳健分类；5) 决策理论阈值校准；6) 隐藏马尔可夫模型-高斯混合模型(HMM-GMM)架构
AI.method: 使用不平衡面板数据集（50+国家，14年，5,159个原始观测值聚合为630个国家-年记录），构建二元市场韧性目标。采用四分类器比较（逻辑回归、朴素贝叶斯、随机森林、梯度提升），通过5折时间序列交叉验证。引入双NLP情感管道（FinBERT机构新闻信号+VADER消费者评论分数），HMM-GMM制度检测，以及决策理论阈值校准协议。
AI.findings: 1) HMM-GMM检测到2023-2024年市场条件存在显著分布变化；2) SHAP分析显示log(GDP_pc)比政策得分贡献更大，挑战政策优先投资论点；3) 确定78%为2024年制度转变条件下的最优生存概率边界；4) 开发风险调整韧性指数(RARI)并为31个市场提供资本配置建议。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出首个集成二元韧性分类、双NLP情感管道、正式制度检测和决策理论校准的DA-RAML系统；2) 引入HMM-GMM架构用于制度检测；3) 挑战政策优先投资论点，强调经济基础的重要性；4) 为分布变化下的预测提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为基础设施规划者和政策制定者提供更准确的EV市场韧性预测工具；2) 识别78%决策边界作为资本配置阈值；3) 提供31个市场的具体部署建议；4) 开发风险调整韧性指数(RARI)支持投资决策。

title: Educational Mobility Across Multiple Generations in Indonesia
affiliations: Institute for Fiscal Studies (IFS), Bank of Italy, Charles III University of Madrid and

detail.title: Educational Mobility Across Multiple Generations in Indonesia

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Standard intergenerational measures have been shown to understate the long-run persistence of socioeconomic advantages in developed countries. We study theoretically and empirically whether this pattern extends to less developed settings, using Indonesia as a case study. Using the Indonesian Family Life Survey (IFLS) and Census data, we study multigenerational correlations in education across three generations. Contrary to previous findings, we observe greater multigenerational mobility than parent-child correlations alone would suggest. We develop a theoretical framework to highlight two key factors influencing multigenerational dynamics in developing countries: (1) financial and credit constraints, and (2) cultural norms related to marital sorting. To confirm their relevance, we exploit regional variations in exposure to the 1997-98 Asian financial crisis and in marital customs.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，与发达国家不同，印度尼西亚的多代教育流动性比仅考虑父母-子女相关性所显示的更高，这主要归因于发展中国家的金融约束和婚姻文化规范。
AI.research_question: 在发展中国家，多代社会经济优势的长期持续性是否与发达国家不同？具体来说，印度尼西亚的多代教育流动性模式如何？
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明，发达国家的标准代际测量低估了社会经济优势的长期持续性。但这一模式是否适用于发展中国家尚不清楚，需要研究发展中国家特有的因素（如金融约束、文化规范）如何影响多代流动性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建理论框架强调影响发展中国家多代动态的两个关键因素：1) 金融和信贷约束；2) 与婚姻匹配相关的文化规范。
AI.method: 使用印度尼西亚家庭生活调查（IFLS）和人口普查数据，研究三代人的教育相关性。利用1997-98年亚洲金融危机的区域暴露差异和婚姻习俗的区域差异来验证理论框架。
AI.findings: 与发达国家模式相反，印度尼西亚的多代教育流动性比仅考虑父母-子女相关性所显示的更高。金融约束和婚姻文化规范是解释这一差异的关键因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 挑战了发达国家多代持续性模式普遍适用的假设；2) 建立了适用于发展中国家的多代流动性理论框架；3) 强调了金融约束和文化规范在发展中国家的独特作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为发展中国家的教育政策提供新视角；2) 帮助理解金融约束如何影响代际流动性；3) 为考虑文化因素的社会流动性政策提供依据。

title: Workforce Quality and Early Childhood Development at Scale
affiliations: Institute for Fiscal Studies (IFS), University College London and Institute for Fiscal Studies (IFS)

detail.title: Workforce Quality and Early Childhood Development at Scale

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Early childhood programmes frequently lose effectiveness at scale, yet the role of the workforce remains poorly understood. We document substantial heterogeneity in workforce effectiveness in England's national home-visiting programme for first-time teenage mothers, despite a highly-structured curriculum and well-qualified staff. Exploiting quasi-random assignment of mothers to family nurses, we estimate that a one standard deviation increase in workforce effectiveness raises children's cognitive and socio-emotional development by 0.20-0.23 SD. Structural quality — observable worker characteristics — does not predict effectiveness, but process quality — how visits are delivered — does. Greater effectiveness is linked with improvements in maternal mental health and risk behaviours.

AI.tldr: 英国针对青少年母亲的全国性家访项目中，尽管有结构化课程和合格员工，但工作人员效果存在显著差异。研究发现工作人员效果每提高一个标准差，儿童认知和社交情感发展可提升0.20-0.23个标准差。结构质量（可观察的员工特征）不能预测效果，但过程质量（家访实施方式）可以。更有效的工作与母亲心理健康改善和风险行为减少相关。
AI.research_question: 早期儿童项目规模化后效果下降，工作人员在其中扮演什么角色？在英国针对青少年母亲的全国性家访项目中，工作人员效果存在多大程度的异质性？哪些因素能预测工作人员的有效性？
AI.motivation: 早期儿童项目在规模化实施时经常失去有效性，但工作人员的作用尚未得到充分理解。需要探究在高度结构化的课程和合格员工条件下，工作人员效果差异的来源及其对儿童发展的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于早期干预项目效果异质性理论，区分结构质量（可观察的员工特征）和过程质量（服务实施方式）对项目效果的影响。关注工作人员效果差异对儿童发展的因果效应。
AI.method: 利用英国全国性家访项目中母亲被准随机分配给家庭护士的自然实验设计，采用准随机分配方法估计工作人员效果差异对儿童发展的因果影响。分析结构质量和过程质量对工作人员效果的预测能力。
AI.findings: 1. 工作人员效果存在显著异质性；2. 工作人员效果每提高一个标准差，儿童认知和社交情感发展提升0.20-0.23个标准差；3. 结构质量（员工特征）不能预测效果；4. 过程质量（家访实施方式）能预测效果；5. 更有效的工作与母亲心理健康改善和风险行为减少相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次量化了早期儿童项目中工作人员效果的异质性及其对儿童发展的因果影响；2. 区分了结构质量和过程质量的不同作用，强调过程质量的重要性；3. 为理解项目规模化效果下降提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了改善早期儿童项目效果的明确方向：关注服务实施过程而非员工特征；2. 为项目管理者提供了评估和提升工作人员效果的具体方法；3. 强调了母亲心理健康改善作为中介机制的重要性。

title: Climate Change, Green Budget and Economic Sustainable Development
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Massey University, Albany campus and Central University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Climate Change, Green Budget and Economic Sustainable Development
detail.abstract: Green budget tagging has emerged as a central fiscal governance reform, yet its causal macroeconomic impact remains unidentified. We provide the first causal evaluation of green budget tagging on total factor productivity (TFP), exploiting staggered cross-country adoption as a quasi-natural experiment. Applying the doubly robust difference-in-differences estimator of Callaway and Sant'Anna (2021) to a balanced panel of 163 economies over 2005–2022, we find that green budget adoption generates statistically and economically significant TFP gains. Mediation analysis identifies three transmission channels: green budget tagging expands clean energy financing by reducing capital market information asymmetry (the financing channel); lowers household search costs for low-carbon energy substitution, stimulating demand-side transitions (the consumption channel); and strengthens green innovation incentives by providing credible long-run fiscal commitments (the innovation channel). Treatment effects are substantially moderated by economic freedom and government integrity, consistent with market institutions and governance quality being necessary complements to fiscal transparency reform. Heterogeneity analysis confirms effects are significantly larger in non-OECD and developing economies. These findings position green budgeting as an institution-building fiscal reform with direct implications for multilateral climate finance and fiscal reform sequencing in emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 绿色预算标签化作为财政治理改革，通过三重传导机制（融资、消费、创新）显著提升全要素生产率，效果在非OECD和发展中经济体更明显，受经济自由和政府诚信调节。
AI.research_question: 绿色预算标签化对全要素生产率（TFP）的因果影响是什么？其传导机制如何？制度条件如何调节这种影响？
AI.motivation: 绿色预算标签化已成为核心财政治理改革，但其宏观经济因果影响尚未被识别，需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财政透明度、信息不对称理论、制度互补性理论，探讨绿色预算标签化通过市场机制和治理质量影响经济效率的路径。
AI.method: 采用Callaway和Sant'Anna（2021）的双重稳健双重差分法，利用163个经济体2005-2022年的平衡面板数据，将绿色预算标签化的交错采用作为准自然实验。
AI.findings: 绿色预算标签化产生统计和经济上显著的TFP增益。通过三个传导渠道：1）融资渠道-减少资本市场信息不对称；2）消费渠道-降低家庭低碳能源替代搜索成本；3）创新渠道-提供可信的长期财政承诺。效果受经济自由和政府诚信显著调节，在非OECD和发展中经济体更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次因果识别绿色预算标签化的宏观经济影响；揭示三重传导机制；提出制度互补性理论框架，强调财政透明度改革需要市场制度和治理质量的配合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多边气候融资提供政策依据；为新兴经济体财政改革排序提供指导；将绿色预算定位为具有制度建设功能的财政改革工具。

title: THE DESIGN OF GOAL-SETTING FOR ENERGY CONSERVATION： PRIVATE VS. PUBLIC GOAL DISCLOSURE IN A FIELD EXPERIMENT
affiliations: XJTU, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Drew University

detail.title: THE DESIGN OF GOAL-SETTING FOR ENERGY CONSERVATION： PRIVATE VS. PUBLIC GOAL DISCLOSURE IN A FIELD EXPERIMENT
detail.abstract: Abstract. Reducing residential electricity consumption is a key component of climate mitigation, and goal-setting is a widely used low-cost behavioral intervention. However, it remains unclear whether making self-set conservation goals and subsequent goal achievement publicly visible improves or undermines effectiveness. Public disclosure may strengthen conservation through social accountability and reputational incentives, but it may also backfire by creating pressure or reactance. We conducted a field experiment involving 179 student dormitories at a Chinese university, randomly assigned to a self-set private goal treatment, a self-set public goal treatment in which goal levels and achievement status were publicly disclosed, or a control group. During the four-week intervention, the private goal treatment significantly reduced electricity consumption by 13.2% relative to the control group, whereas the public goal treatment produced no statistically significant effect. The private-goal effect did not persist after the intervention ended. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the private goal treatment was more effective in male dormitories, while no significant gender differences emerged in the public goal treatment. Goal achievement played an important role in sustaining conservation: dormitories that achieved their goals reduced electricity use by 19.7% in the private goal group and 32.4% in the public goal group after the intervention.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实地实验发现，在宿舍节电行为干预中，私密自设目标比公开自设目标更有效，能显著降低13.2%用电量，而公开目标无显著效果。目标达成对持续节能至关重要。
AI.research_question: 公开披露自设节能目标及其达成情况会增强还是削弱行为干预的效果？
AI.motivation: 住宅用电减排是气候减缓的关键，目标设定是广泛使用的低成本行为干预。但公开披露目标及其达成情况可能通过社会问责和声誉激励增强效果，也可能因压力或抗拒心理而产生反效果，这一问题尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的目标设定理论、社会问责机制、声誉激励理论，以及心理学中的抗拒心理理论。
AI.method: 在中国某大学的179个学生宿舍进行随机对照实地实验，分为三组：私密自设目标组、公开自设目标组（目标水平和达成状态公开披露）、控制组。干预持续四周。
AI.findings: 1. 私密目标组比控制组显著减少13.2%用电量；2. 公开目标组无统计显著效果；3. 干预结束后私密目标效果未持续；4. 私密目标在男生宿舍更有效；5. 达成目标的宿舍在干预后持续节能（私密组19.7%，公开组32.4%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了公开披露在目标设定干预中的反效果；2. 区分了私密与公开目标设定的不同作用机制；3. 强调了目标达成对行为持续性的重要性；4. 提供了社会问责机制边界条件的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为节能政策设计提供指导：私密目标设定比公开披露更有效；2. 建议关注目标达成以促进持续行为改变；3. 针对不同性别群体可差异化设计干预策略；4. 为低成本行为干预提供实证支持。

title: Dynamic Laffer Curve and Public Green Bonds in the Energy Transition: A Schumpeterian Growth Perspective†
affiliations: University of Vigo,  and

detail.title: Dynamic Laffer Curve and Public Green Bonds in the Energy Transition: A Schumpeterian Growth Perspective†
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether the energy transition can be financed without raising taxes by analyzing the macroeconomic effects of public green bonds within an endogenous growth framework. We develop a dynamic general equilibrium model with Schumpeterian innovation and creative destruction to assess how debt-financed subsidies for renewable energy production and R&D affect long-run growth, fiscal sustainability, and emissions reduction. The model formalizes Blanchard’s intuition that public investment can “pay for itself” when returns exceed borrowing costs, extending it to the context of climate policy. Our results show that under specific technological, fiscal, and structural conditions, green-bond-financed subsidies to renewable energy can be dynamically self-financing through a Laffer-type effect: higher subsidies accelerate innovation and growth, expanding future tax bases sufficiently to offset initial deficits. In contrast, subsidizing R&D alone is less efficient due to higher risk and debt-servicing costs. The analysis demonstrates that economies with limited fiscal space—such as the European Union—can foster decarbonization and economic expansion by strategically issuing public green bonds. Even when full self-financing is unattainable, such instruments reduce pressure on public budgets and future tax rates. Overall, our findings highlight that well-designed green debt policies can jointly promote growth, fiscal stability, and emissions reduction, providing a credible pathway toward a low-carbon economy.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在不增税的情况下通过发行公共绿色债券为能源转型融资的可行性。研究发现，在特定条件下，通过绿色债券融资的可再生能源补贴可以实现动态自我融资，促进经济增长、财政可持续性和减排。
AI.research_question: 能源转型能否在不增税的情况下通过公共绿色债券融资？绿色债券融资的补贴如何影响长期增长、财政可持续性和减排？
AI.motivation: 许多经济体面临财政空间有限的问题，难以通过增税为能源转型融资。研究探索通过公共绿色债券为可再生能源补贴融资的可行性，为气候政策提供财政可持续的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生增长理论、熊彼特创新与创造性破坏理论、动态一般均衡模型、布兰查德关于公共投资"自我支付"的直觉、拉弗曲线效应
AI.method: 构建包含熊彼特创新和创造性破坏的动态一般均衡模型，分析债务融资的可再生能源生产和研发补贴对宏观经济的影响
AI.findings:
1. 在特定技术、财政和结构条件下，绿色债券融资的可再生能源补贴可通过拉弗型效应实现动态自我融资
2. 补贴加速创新和增长，扩大未来税基，足以抵消初始赤字
3. 单独补贴研发效率较低，因为风险更高且债务服务成本更大
4. 财政空间有限的经济体（如欧盟）可通过战略发行公共绿色债券促进脱碳和经济扩张
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将布兰查德的"自我支付"公共投资直觉扩展到气候政策领域
2. 在熊彼特内生增长框架中形式化绿色债券融资的宏观经济效应
3. 提出绿色债券融资补贴的"动态自我融资"理论机制
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为财政空间有限的经济体提供不增税的能源转型融资方案
2. 指导政策制定者设计促进增长、财政稳定和减排的绿色债务政策
3. 为欧盟等经济体提供具体的政策实施路径
4. 即使无法完全自我融资，也能减轻公共预算压力和未来税率负担

title: Swarm Vigilance Intelligence: A Biomimetic Framework for Collective Sensing and Immune-Style Verification in Complex Risk Analysis - Data Analysis Report on Complex Risk Information Systems
affiliations: The University of Western Australia

detail.title: Swarm Vigilance Intelligence: A Biomimetic Framework for Collective Sensing and Immune-Style Verification in Complex Risk Analysis - Data Analysis Report on Complex Risk Information Systems
detail.abstract: This report presents a journal-ready analysis of a dual-layer sample architecture developed for complex risk information systems. The architecture combines a real public sample pool with a synthetic derived sample layer. The former integrates four authoritative resources: the GDELT 2.0 global event database, the CrisisMMD multimodal crisis dataset, the MAVEN-ERE event-relation extraction dataset, and the MIRACL multilingual retrieval dataset. The latter is generated from empirically grounded rules derived from real samples and evaluated under a NIST-aligned framework spanning utility, fidelity, and risk. The synthetic layer contains 3,000 records across 10 languages, 5 information modalities, 4 perturbation types, and 3 risk levels. Results indicate complete data integrity, with all 20 fields valid across all 3,000 records; strict monotonicity of risk labels, with mean threat scores increasing from 49.18 in the low-risk tier to 54.71 in the medium-risk tier and 60.60 in the high-risk tier; and differentiated perturbation profiles across risk levels, with semantic perturbation accounting for the largest share (38.8%), while relation fabrication accounts for the smallest share (6.4%) and is concentrated in the low-risk range. Taken together, these findings establish a clear evidentiary basis for data quality and provide a robust empirical foundation for subsequent human-machine collaborative experiments and research on distributed leadership in high-risk information systems.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种用于复杂风险信息系统的双层样本架构，结合真实公共样本池和合成衍生样本层。合成层包含3000条记录，涵盖10种语言、5种信息模态、4种扰动类型和3种风险等级。结果显示数据完整性良好，风险标签具有严格单调性，不同风险等级的扰动特征存在差异。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够有效支持复杂风险信息系统研究的双层样本架构？该架构如何结合真实和合成数据来确保数据质量和实证基础？
AI.motivation: 复杂风险信息系统研究需要高质量、多样化的数据集，但现有数据集往往在语言覆盖、信息模态、扰动类型和风险等级方面存在局限性。需要开发一个综合性的样本架构来支持后续的人机协作实验和高风险信息系统中的分布式领导力研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于NIST对齐的数据质量评估框架（效用、保真度、风险）；风险信息系统的数据架构理论；合成数据生成与评估的理论基础。
AI.method: 开发双层样本架构：1）真实公共样本池整合GDELT 2.0、CrisisMMD、MAVEN-ERE、MIRACL四个权威资源；2）合成衍生样本层基于真实样本的经验规则生成，包含3000条记录，涵盖10种语言、5种信息模态、4种扰动类型、3种风险等级；使用NIST对齐框架评估数据质量。
AI.findings: 1）数据完整性：所有20个字段在3000条记录中均有效；2）风险标签严格单调性：低风险层平均威胁分数49.18，中风险层54.71，高风险层60.60；3）扰动特征差异：语义扰动占比最大（38.8%），关系伪造占比最小（6.4%）且集中在低风险范围。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个用于复杂风险信息系统的双层样本架构理论框架；建立了基于NIST对齐的数据质量评估标准；为高风险信息系统中的数据质量研究提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个包含3000条多语言、多模态记录的合成数据集；提供了可用于人机协作实验和分布式领导力研究的实证基础；为风险信息系统开发者提供了数据质量评估的实用框架。

title: Pay-Per-Crawl Pricing for AI: The LM-Tree Agent
affiliations: Yale University, Yale University and Yale University

detail.title: Pay-Per-Crawl Pricing for AI: The LM-Tree Agent
detail.abstract: As AI systems shift from directing users to content toward consuming it directly, publishers need a new revenue model: charging AI crawlers for content access. This model, called pay-per-crawl, must solve a problem of mechanism selection at scale: content is too heterogeneous for a fixed pricing framework. Different sub-types warrant not only different price levels but different pricing rules based on different unstructured features, and there are too many to enumerate or design by hand. We propose the LM Tree, an adaptive pricing agent that grows a segmentation tree over the content library, using LLMs to discover what distinguishes high-value from low-value items and apply those attributes at scale, from binary purchase feedback alone. We evaluate the LM Tree on real content from a major German technology publisher, using 8,939 articles and 80,451 buyer queries with willingness-to-pay calibrated from actual AI crawler traffic. The LM Tree achieves a 65% revenue gain over a single static price and a 47% gain over two-category pricing, outperforming even the publisher's own 8-segment editorial taxonomy by 40%-recovering content distinctions the publisher's own categories miss.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为LM Tree的自适应定价代理，用于解决AI爬虫访问内容时的定价问题。通过使用LLM发现区分高价值和低价值内容的特征，并仅从二进制购买反馈中构建内容库的分割树，实现了比传统定价方法更高的收入。
AI.research_question: 当AI系统从引导用户访问内容转向直接消费内容时，出版商如何为AI爬虫设计有效的定价机制？具体而言，如何解决内容异质性带来的大规模机制选择问题？
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统从引导用户访问内容转向直接消费内容，出版商需要新的收入模式：向AI爬虫收取内容访问费用。然而，内容的高度异质性使得固定定价框架不适用，不同内容子类型不仅需要不同的价格水平，还需要基于不同非结构化特征的不同定价规则，数量太多无法手动枚举或设计。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 机制设计理论：解决大规模定价机制选择问题
2. 分割树算法：用于内容库的层次化分类
3. 大语言模型（LLM）应用：发现区分高价值和低价值内容的特征
4. 自适应定价理论：基于反馈的动态定价机制
AI.method: 提出LM Tree自适应定价代理，在内容库上构建分割树，使用LLM发现区分高价值和低价值项目的特征，并仅从二进制购买反馈中大规模应用这些属性。使用德国主要技术出版商的8,939篇文章和80,451个买家查询进行评估，支付意愿基于实际AI爬虫流量校准。
AI.findings: LM Tree相比单一静态价格实现65%的收入增长，相比两类别定价实现47%的增长，甚至比出版商自己的8段编辑分类法高出40%，恢复了出版商自己分类遗漏的内容区别。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了LM Tree自适应定价代理的理论框架
2. 将LLM应用于大规模定价机制设计问题
3. 发展了基于分割树的内容价值发现方法
4. 为异质内容定价提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为出版商提供了向AI爬虫收费的实际解决方案
2. 实现了比传统定价方法显著更高的收入
3. 可以自动发现出版商自己分类系统遗漏的内容价值区别
4. 为AI时代的内容变现提供了可行的商业模式

title: NIME: A Community of Communities
affiliations: Ritsumeikan University

detail.title: NIME: A Community of Communities
detail.abstract:
Commentary on “Fourteen Years of NIME: The Value and Meaning of ‘Community’ in Interactive
Music Research” by A. Marquez-Borbon & P. Stapleton.

AI.tldr: 本文是对Marquez-Borbon & Stapleton关于NIME社区价值与意义研究的评论性文章，探讨了NIME社区14年发展中的价值建构、身份认同和学术实践问题。
AI.research_question: NIME社区在14年发展中如何建构其价值体系？社区身份认同如何影响互动音乐研究的发展？
AI.motivation: 随着NIME社区不断发展壮大，需要反思社区的价值取向、身份认同和学术实践，以确保其持续健康发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社区理论、学术社区建构理论、价值共创理论、身份认同理论
AI.method: 文献分析、历史回顾、批判性评论、质性分析
AI.findings: NIME社区在14年发展中形成了独特的价值体系，社区身份认同对研究方向和学术实践有重要影响，但也面临价值冲突和身份危机。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了学术社区价值建构理论，提出了互动音乐研究社区的身份认同模型，拓展了社区理论在跨学科研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为NIME社区发展提供反思框架，帮助研究者理解社区价值取向，促进更包容和可持续的学术实践。

title: A Pragmatic Approach to Regulating AI Agents
affiliations: European University Viadrina Frankfurt (Oder) - European New School of Digital Studies and University of Oxford - Said Business School

detail.title: A Pragmatic Approach to Regulating AI Agents
detail.abstract: The current advancement in and deployment of agentic AI systems has created a set of key challenges for the legal frameworks that govern their use. We cover two central components: first, the regulatory classification of agents under the EU AI Act, and second, the legal status and validity of autonomous actions within the established framework of EU contract law. We argue that the unique capacity of agents to autonomously reason, plan, and execute tasks across disparate external systems necessitates a fundamental shift in oversight toward the orchestration layer, where multi-agent interactions introduce novel risks of misalignment. While agents generally utilise general-purpose AI models, we posit that their structural complexity and cross-system permeability require them to be regulated as "AI systems" with distinct obligations under the AI Act. Consequently, our proposals highlight the need for robust accountability mechanisms to manage this heightened autonomy. On the contractual side, we advocate for a "traffic light" system of staggered task authorization based on operational risk and the creation of a statutory list of non-delegable legal acts. By implementing these measures, we provide a pragmatic pathway to ensure that the increasing autonomy of AI agents remains firmly anchored in human accountability and existing legal standards.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了AI智能体在法律框架下面临的挑战，提出了在欧盟AI法案下将智能体归类为"AI系统"的建议，并主张在合同法中建立基于风险的授权机制，以确保AI自主性不脱离人类责任和法律标准。
AI.research_question: 如何将具有自主推理、规划和跨系统执行任务能力的AI智能体纳入欧盟AI法案和合同法框架进行有效监管？
AI.motivation: AI智能体系统的快速发展和部署对现有法律框架提出了关键挑战，特别是其自主性和跨系统交互能力带来的监管空白和风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟AI法案的监管分类框架、欧盟合同法原则、AI系统责任理论、智能体自主性理论。
AI.method: 法律分析、监管框架比较、风险分析、政策建议制定。
AI.findings: AI智能体的结构复杂性和跨系统渗透性要求将其作为"AI系统"进行监管；多智能体交互在编排层引入新的错位风险；需要转向编排层监督。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI智能体监管的编排层监督理论；发展了基于风险的任务授权框架；完善了AI系统责任分配理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议在欧盟AI法案下将智能体归类为AI系统；提出基于风险的"红绿灯"任务授权机制；建议制定不可委托法律行为的法定清单。

title: Expanding Paternity Leave: Effects on Beliefs, Norms, and Gender Gaps
affiliations: Princeton University - Princeton School of Public and International Affairs, London School of Economics, WZB Berlin Social Science Center, Copenhagen Business School - Department of Economics, University of Copenhagen - Department of Economics, Copenhagen Business School and University of Copenhagen

detail.title: Expanding Paternity Leave: Effects on Beliefs, Norms, and Gender Gaps

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study whether policy can shift gendered beliefs, norms, and labor market outcomes by exploiting a major expansion of earmarked paternity leave in Denmark. The reform generated large first-stage effects, substantially reallocating leave from mothers to fathers. Using a regression discontinuity design combined with new survey data linked to administrative records, we show that the reform makes parents more supportive of paternity leave, shifts gender-role beliefs in a progressive direction, and reduces perceived differences in childcare ability. The reform also narrows gender gaps in earnings and hours worked. The earnings gap falls by 34pp in the first year following childbirth (during leave) and by 2.8pp in the second year (after leave). These results demonstrate that policy can meaningfully influence beliefs, norms, and gender inequality. On the other hand, earmarking restricts families' ability to allocate leave freely and lowers leave satisfaction, highlighting a central trade-off inherent in paternalistic policies.

AI.tldr: 丹麦一项专门陪产假政策的重大扩展研究表明，政策能够显著改变性别观念、规范并缩小性别收入差距，但同时也限制了家庭自由分配假期并降低了满意度，揭示了家长式政策的内在权衡。
AI.research_question: 政策是否能够改变性别观念、规范以及劳动力市场结果？专门陪产假政策如何影响父母的性别角色信念、育儿能力认知以及性别收入差距？
AI.motivation: 尽管性别平等政策日益增多，但关于政策能否真正改变根深蒂固的性别观念和规范仍存在争议。本研究旨在通过丹麦专门陪产假政策扩展这一自然实验，实证检验政策对性别信念、规范和劳动力市场结果的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于性别角色理论、社会规范理论和政策干预理论，研究探讨政策如何通过制度设计影响个体信念和社会规范，进而改变劳动力市场中的性别不平等。
AI.method: 采用断点回归设计，结合新调查数据与行政记录数据，分析丹麦专门陪产假政策扩展对父母性别观念、育儿认知和劳动力市场结果的影响。
AI.findings: 政策显著将假期从母亲重新分配给父亲；使父母更支持陪产假；推动性别角色观念向进步方向发展；减少育儿能力感知差异；缩小性别收入差距（第一年减少34个百分点，第二年减少2.8个百分点）。但同时，专门化政策限制了家庭自由分配假期并降低了满意度。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政策干预如何影响性别观念和社会规范提供了实证证据；揭示了家长式政策在促进性别平等与限制家庭自主权之间的内在权衡；深化了对制度设计如何塑造性别角色认知的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计有效的性别平等政策提供了实证依据；揭示了专门陪产假政策在缩小性别收入差距方面的实际效果；提醒政策制定者需要平衡政策目标与家庭自主权。

title: Housing Supply, Property Insurance, and Exposure to Wildfire Risk

detail.title: Housing Supply, Property Insurance, and Exposure to Wildfire Risk

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: In the past two decades, about half of the new homes in the United States were built in areas at risk of natural hazards. Why is residential development exposed to such risk? I argue that regulated property-insurance pricing and land-use regulations contribute to this pattern. I study this mechanism in the metropolitan area of San Diego, California, where insurance rules compress the premium gradient with respect to wildfire risk and safer locations are highly regulated and built out. Using detailed spatial data on zoning, wildfire risk, housing, commuting, and premiums, I estimate a quantitative urban model of household location choice, housing supply, and insurance supply. The estimates imply that wildfire premiums are 10.5% below actuarially fair pricing, that the average amenity cost of current wildfire risk is equivalent to 3.5% of income, and that the total present-value welfare cost of current wildfire risk, including property damages, is $17.5 billion. This aggregate cost masks substantial incidence heterogeneity, as owners of safe land benefit from equilibrium scarcity effects. Counterfactuals show that housing supply and insurance pricing interact in determining incidence. In the benchmark specification, targeted housing reforms leave the aggregate effect of cost-based insurance nearly unchanged while attenuating its burden on workers: relative to baseline, workers' wildfire costs rise by 2.3% under insurance reform alone, but fall by 0.9% under the joint reform.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了美国住宅开发为何暴露于自然灾害风险，发现受监管的财产保险定价和土地使用法规是主要原因。通过对圣地亚哥大都市区的研究，发现野火保险费率低于精算公平定价10.5%，当前野火风险的总福利成本达175亿美元。
AI.research_question: 为什么美国的住宅开发会暴露在自然灾害风险中？受监管的财产保险定价和土地使用法规如何影响这种风险暴露模式？
AI.motivation: 过去20年中，美国约一半的新建住宅位于自然灾害风险区域。这种风险暴露模式对居民福利和财产安全构成严重威胁，需要理解其背后的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于城市经济学理论，结合家庭区位选择、住房供给和保险供给的定量城市模型，分析保险定价和土地法规如何影响风险暴露。
AI.method: 使用圣地亚哥大都市区的详细空间数据（分区、野火风险、住房、通勤、保险费率），估计家庭区位选择、住房供给和保险供给的定量城市模型。
AI.findings: 1) 野火保险费率低于精算公平定价10.5%；2) 当前野火风险的舒适度成本相当于收入的3.5%；3) 当前野火风险的总现值福利成本（包括财产损失）达175亿美元；4) 安全土地所有者从均衡稀缺效应中获益；5) 住房供给和保险定价在决定福利分配方面相互作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了整合保险定价和土地法规的城市经济学模型；2) 揭示了保险定价扭曲如何影响风险暴露；3) 阐明了住房供给和保险政策的相互作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 量化了野火风险的经济成本；2) 表明针对性住房改革可以减轻保险改革对工人的负担；3) 为政策制定者提供了改善风险管理和住房政策的实证依据。

title: Perils of Parallelism: Transaction Fee Mechanisms under Execution Uncertainty
affiliations: Duke University, Yale University, Yale University and Duke University

detail.title: Perils of Parallelism: Transaction Fee Mechanisms under Execution Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Modern blockchains increasingly rely on parallel execution to improve throughput. We show several industry and academic transaction fee mechanisms (TFMs) struggle to simultaneously account for execution parallelism while remaining performant and fair. First, if parallelism affects fees, adversarial protocol manipulations that offset possible benefits to throughput by introducing fake transactions become rational: users can insert functionally useless parallel transactions solely to reduce fees, and schedulers can create useless sequential transactions to increase revenue. Execution contingency, a core feature of expressive programming languages, both exacerbates the aforementioned threats and introduces new ones: (1) users may overpay for unused resources, and (2) scheduler revenue is harmed when reserved scheduling slots go unused due to contingency. We introduce a framework for this challenging setting, and prove an impossibility, highlighting an inherent tension: both parallelism and contingency involve a trade-off between minimizing risks for users and schedulers, as favoring one comes at the expense of the other. To complete the picture, we introduce fee mechanisms and prove that they achieve the boundaries of this trade-off. Our results provide rigorous foundations for evaluating designs advanced by notable blockchains, such as Sui and Monad.

AI.tldr: 本文研究区块链并行执行环境下的交易费机制设计挑战，指出现有机制在考虑并行执行时难以同时保证性能与公平性，并揭示了并行性和执行偶发性之间的内在权衡关系。
AI.research_question: 在支持并行执行的区块链环境中，如何设计既能考虑执行并行性，又能保持高性能和公平性的交易费机制？
AI.motivation: 现代区块链依赖并行执行提高吞吐量，但现有交易费机制在考虑并行执行时面临挑战：可能引发协议操纵、虚假交易、资源浪费等问题，需要新的理论框架来指导设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易费机制设计理论、博弈论、并行计算经济学、区块链激励机制设计
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建、不可能性定理证明、机制设计边界分析、形式化证明
AI.findings: 1. 现有交易费机制在并行执行环境下存在操纵漏洞；2. 执行偶发性加剧了用户和调度者之间的风险冲突；3. 存在不可能性结果：并行性和偶发性之间存在固有权衡；4. 提出了达到权衡边界的收费机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了并行区块链交易费机制的分析框架；2. 证明了并行性和执行偶发性之间的不可能性定理；3. 提供了评估Sui、Monad等区块链设计的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为区块链开发者设计并行执行收费机制提供指导；2. 帮助识别和防范协议操纵攻击；3. 为评估现有区块链系统（如Sui、Monad）的设计提供分析工具。

title: Financial Inclusion for Inclusive Growth
affiliations: ESSCA School of Management and University of Orleans, IZA Institute of Labor Economics

detail.title: Financial Inclusion for Inclusive Growth

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using a sample of 67 countries, this article examines how financial inclusion, among other factors, shapes the transition to inclusive and sustainable growth. First, we analyze the heterogeneous and asymmetric relationship between inclusiveness and its main determinants using recent panel quantile regression techniques. Our results suggest that the distributional effects of financial inclusion, institutional quality, and information and communication technology (ICT) diffusion are statistically significant only in the lower tail of the conditional distribution. Although both financial inclusion and ICT diffusion are detrimental to inclusive growth, institutional quality is conducive to greater shared prosperity. Next, we examine the existence of a mediating effect in the process of inclusiveness using non-linear panel threshold modelling. Our results highlight the mediating role of financial inclusion in achieving more inclusive and sustainable growth. While ICT infrastructure negatively impacts growth inclusiveness at low financial inclusion levels, a positive relationship is observed when financial affordability exceeds a certain threshold. Policymakers are called upon to harness the combined impacts of financial inclusion, governance quality, and ICTs to ensure inclusive economic growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用67个国家样本，探讨金融包容性等因素如何影响包容性和可持续增长转型。研究发现金融包容性、制度质量和ICT扩散的分布效应仅在条件分布的下尾显著，金融包容性和ICT扩散对包容性增长有负面影响，而制度质量则促进共享繁荣。研究还发现金融包容性在实现包容性和可持续增长中起中介作用，ICT基础设施在金融包容性低水平时对增长包容性有负面影响，但当金融可及性超过阈值时则呈正相关。
AI.research_question: 金融包容性及其他因素如何影响包容性和可持续增长的转型？金融包容性在包容性增长过程中是否存在中介作用？
AI.motivation: 理解金融包容性、制度质量和ICT扩散如何共同影响包容性和可持续增长，为政策制定者提供实证依据，以促进更公平的经济增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 包容性增长理论、金融包容性理论、制度经济学、ICT扩散对经济发展的影响理论。
AI.method: 使用67个国家样本，采用面板分位数回归技术分析异质性和非对称关系，使用非线性面板阈值模型检验中介效应。
AI.findings: 1. 金融包容性、制度质量和ICT扩散的分布效应仅在条件分布的下尾显著；2. 金融包容性和ICT扩散对包容性增长有负面影响，而制度质量促进共享繁荣；3. 金融包容性在实现包容性和可持续增长中起中介作用；4. ICT基础设施在低金融包容性水平时对增长包容性有负面影响，但当金融可及性超过阈值时呈正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了金融包容性、制度质量和ICT扩散对包容性增长的异质性影响；2. 验证了金融包容性在包容性增长过程中的中介作用；3. 提出了金融包容性阈值效应理论，解释ICT基础设施影响的条件性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供实证证据，强调需要综合运用金融包容性、治理质量和ICT政策；2. 指出金融包容性需要达到一定阈值才能发挥ICT基础设施的积极作用；3. 呼吁政策制定者关注制度质量对共享繁荣的重要性。

title: MarketSense: Do Small AI Models Understand Financial News? An Empirical Study of Compact Language Models and Stock Return Reactions

detail.title: MarketSense: Do Small AI Models Understand Financial News? An Empirical Study of Compact Language Models and Stock Return Reactions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used only publicly available financial news data and stock price data. No human participants were involved. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work was conducted independently.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether compact, domain-adapted language models can detect economically meaningful sentiment in financial headlines. Using roughly one thousand news items for nine large-cap tickers between April and October 2025, we compare FinBERT—a finance-tuned model—with Distil BERT—a compressed general model. FinBERT’s daily sentiment correlates positively with same-day stock returns, whereas DistilBERT shows no consistent signal. The results suggest that domain adapta tion matters more than model size for resource-efficient financial NLP.

AI.tldr: 研究比较了金融领域调优的FinBERT模型与压缩通用模型DistilBERT在金融新闻情感分析中的表现，发现FinBERT的日度情感与同日股票回报呈正相关，而DistilBERT无一致信号，表明领域适配比模型大小对资源高效金融NLP更重要。
AI.research_question: 紧凑、领域适配的语言模型能否检测金融标题中具有经济意义的情感？
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型在金融NLP中的应用增加，需要评估领域适配与模型压缩之间的权衡，以开发资源高效的金融情感分析工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然语言处理中的领域适配理论、模型压缩理论，以及金融情感分析的有效性假设。
AI.method: 使用约1000条2025年4月至10月期间9个大盘股标的新闻标题，比较金融领域调优的FinBERT模型与压缩通用模型DistilBERT的情感分析能力，分析其日度情感得分与同日股票回报的相关性。
AI.findings: FinBERT的日度情感与同日股票回报呈正相关，而DistilBERT未显示一致信号，表明领域适配对金融情感分析的有效性比模型大小更重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 为领域适配与模型压缩在金融NLP中的相对重要性提供了实证证据，支持领域专业知识在资源受限环境下的优先性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构选择资源高效的NLP模型提供指导，建议优先考虑领域适配而非单纯追求模型大小，有助于降低计算成本同时保持分析有效性。

title: Artificial Intelligence Integration in Financial Planning & Analysis: A Framework for Advancing Supply Chain Financial Resilience and Operational Competitiveness in U.S. Consumer Packaged Goods Industries
affiliations: Brigham Young University

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence Integration in Financial Planning & Analysis: A Framework for Advancing Supply Chain Financial Resilience and Operational Competitiveness in U.S. Consumer Packaged Goods Industries
detail.abstract:
The U.S. Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) and beverage distribution sector — generating an estimated $2.1 trillion in annual economic output and employing approximately 3.4 million Americans — continues to rely on static, Excel-driven annual budgeting processes that produce forecast error rates of 20–30%, resulting in systematic capital misallocation,
suboptimal cost management, and diminished financial resilience (AFP, 2023; Gartner, 2022). The COVID-19 pandemic exposed these vulnerabilities at national scale, prompting Executive Order 14017 (The White House, 2021) to designate supply chain resilience a national priority and identifying enhanced financial planning capabilities as a key enabler. Despite mounting evidence of the transformative potential of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) in financial forecasting (Makridakis et al., 2022; Carbonneau et al., 2008), fewer than 18% of U.S. CPG organizations have integrated ML capabilities into their core FP&A processes — the lowest adoption rate of any major U.S. industry sector and 43 percentage points below financial services (Gartner, 2022; Deloitte, 2022).

This paper presents both a theoretical synthesis and original empirical evidence drawn from a multi-phase AI-enhanced FP&A implementation at a large-scale, multi-state U.S. beverage distribution enterprise (hereafter 'the case organization') managing $500M+ in annual operating expenditures and $400M+ in capital initiatives across 13 U.S. states. The
implementation deployed SQL-based automated data pipelines, Power BI real-time Torres Erpel | AI Integration in FP&A — U.S. CPG Supply Chains (2025) | Page 2 financial intelligence dashboards, and ML-informed rolling monthly forecast models
across a 14-month deployment period, with performance measured over a subsequent 12- month period. Empirical outcomes include: (1) cumulative cost savings of $9.1 million across six identified categories; (2) a 35% improvement in reporting efficiency, reducing monthly cycle time from 340 to 221 finance labor hours, representing approximately
$121,380 in annual labor value; (3) MAPE reductions of 46–80% across five major variable cost categories, with fleet and logistics forecast error declining from 27.4% to  5.7%; and (4) a structural reallocation of FP&A team capacity from transactional processing to strategic advisory functions. Benchmarking against McKinsey (2020), AFP (2023), and Gartner (2022) comparator data confirms that these outcomes meet or exceed industry benchmarks for comparable implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过美国饮料分销企业的案例研究，展示了AI/ML在财务规划与分析中的实际应用效果，实现了显著的成本节约、效率提升和预测准确性改善。
AI.research_question: AI和机器学习如何改善美国CPG和饮料分销行业的财务规划与分析流程，特别是在预测准确性、成本管理和运营效率方面？
AI.motivation: 美国CPG和饮料分销行业年产值2.1万亿美元，但依赖静态Excel预算流程导致20-30%的预测误差，造成资本错配和财务韧性不足。尽管AI/ML在财务预测中具有变革潜力，但该行业ML采用率仅18%，是所有主要行业中最低的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合AI/ML在财务预测中的理论（Makridakis等，2022；Carbonneau等，2008）与供应链韧性理论（白宫行政令14017），构建AI增强FP&A的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用多阶段AI增强FP&A实施的案例研究方法，研究对象为年运营支出5亿美元、资本项目4亿美元的大型多州饮料分销企业。实施包括SQL自动化数据管道、Power BI实时仪表板和ML滚动月度预测模型，部署期14个月，绩效评估期12个月。
AI.findings: 1) 累计节省910万美元成本；2) 报告效率提升35%，月度周期从340小时减少到221小时，年节省劳动力价值121,380美元；3) 五大可变成本类别MAPE降低46-80%，车队和物流预测误差从27.4%降至5.7%；4) FP&A团队从交易处理转向战略咨询职能。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为AI在FP&A中的应用提供了实证理论支持；2) 扩展了供应链韧性理论在财务规划中的应用；3) 建立了AI增强FP&A的绩效评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为CPG行业提供了可复制的AI/ML实施蓝图；2) 展示了具体的成本节约和效率提升指标；3) 提供了行业基准比较数据；4) 展示了如何将FP&A团队从交易处理转向战略职能。

title: Consumer Protection Law in New Zealand: A Means of Redress for Privacy Harms?

detail.title: Consumer Protection Law in New Zealand: A Means of Redress for Privacy Harms?
detail.abstract: This paper interrogates the growing dissonance between New Zealand's digital economy and its frameworks for consumer redress. It identifies a significant regulatory "void" within the Privacy Act 2020, arguing that the Act's conciliatory enforcement pathway and high remedial "harm threshold"-requiring "significant humiliation" or "loss of dignity"-create an insurmountable barrier for consumers harmed by the modern data-extraction economy. This gap, driven by the "Brussels Effect" pressure to maintain EU adequacy through superficial transparency reforms, is not accidental but a de facto policy choice. The paper's central thesis is that a potent, albeit latent, solution already exists within New Zealand's consumer protection statutes. First, it argues that the Fair Trading Act 1986 provides an immediate pathway for regulatory action: the "overall impression" doctrine, affirmed in Commerce Commission v Viagogo AG, can be directly transposed from "drip pricing" to "drip collection," rendering opaque privacy policies and dark pattern interfaces misleading conduct under section 9. This argument is substantiated by the successful "deterrence-by-enforcement" model pioneered by the ACCC in its actions against Google, Meta, and Trivago, and bolstered by the FTA's new unconscionable conduct provisions. Second, the paper advances a novel argument that the Consumer Guarantees Act 1993 applies to data-related harms, positing that data management is an intrinsic "service" and that a data breach constitutes a per se failure of the guarantee of "reasonable care and skill" under section 28-reframing privacy as service quality and unlocking commercial remedies, including consequential loss, via the Disputes Tribunal. The paper concludes that while activating the Commerce Commission is the immediate imperative, the superior long-term solution is a convergent regulatory model emulating the United Kingdom's Digital Regulation Cooperation Forum.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨新西兰数字经济与消费者救济框架之间的脱节，指出《2020年隐私法》存在监管真空，并提出利用《1986年公平交易法》和《1993年消费者保障法》作为现有解决方案，同时建议效仿英国数字监管合作论坛建立融合监管模式。
AI.research_question: 如何解决新西兰数字经济与消费者救济框架之间的脱节问题，特别是在隐私保护方面存在的监管真空？
AI.motivation: 新西兰数字经济快速发展与消费者救济框架之间存在日益严重的脱节，《2020年隐私法》的和解执行路径和高补救"损害门槛"（要求"显著羞辱"或"尊严丧失"）为受数据提取经济损害的消费者设置了难以逾越的障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. "布鲁塞尔效应"理论：为维持欧盟充分性认定而进行的表面透明度改革压力；2. "整体印象"学说：源自Commerce Commission v Viagogo AG案例；3. "威慑性执法"模式：借鉴澳大利亚竞争与消费者委员会（ACCC）对Google、Meta和Trivago的执法实践；4. 数据管理作为"服务"的理论框架。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、案例研究（包括Commerce Commission v Viagogo AG案例）、比较法分析（借鉴澳大利亚ACCC执法模式和英国数字监管合作论坛）、理论论证。
AI.findings: 1. 《公平交易法》第9条下的"整体印象"学说可直接从"滴漏定价"扩展到"滴漏收集"，将不透明的隐私政策和暗黑模式界面视为误导行为；2. 《消费者保障法》第28条适用于数据相关损害，数据管理构成内在"服务"，数据泄露构成"合理注意和技能"保证的当然违反；3. 现有消费者保护法规已包含解决隐私损害的有效但未充分利用的机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将隐私重新定义为服务质量而非独立权利；2. 提出数据管理作为"服务"的新理论框架；3. 扩展"整体印象"学说在隐私领域的应用；4. 论证消费者保护法规在数字经济中的适应性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为商业委员会提供立即可行的执法路径；2. 为消费者通过争议法庭获得商业救济（包括间接损失）开辟途径；3. 提出效仿英国数字监管合作论坛的融合监管长期解决方案；4. 为政策制定者提供具体改革建议。

title: Rethinking Willpower: A Multivariable Theory of Goal-Aligned Executability

detail.title: Rethinking Willpower: A Multivariable Theory of Goal-Aligned Executability
detail.abstract:
This paper reconceptualizes the cluster of phenomena commonly grouped under everyday labels such as "motivation," "willpower," "concentration," and "mental energy" as a multivariable system governing executability̶that is, the ease with which goal-aligned non-automatic (controlled) processing can be initiated, maintained, allocated, resumed, and restored. This framework is termed the Goal-Aligned Theory of Executability (GATE). Difficulties such as failing to start, failing to continue once started, freezing when too many options are present, degraded judgment after fatigue, or shutdown under anxiety or rumination are often treated as manifestations of a single lack of willpower. GATE argues instead that they reflect different bottleneck structures. 

The framework organizes trait variables, state variables, and context variables, including activation threshold, parallel processing capacity, sustained capacity, processing efficiency, residual capacity, maximum capacity, recovery, background drain, task complexity, emotional noise, habit formation, and externalization. It links this variable map to a diagnostic-prescriptive structure of symptoms → candidate variables → intervention levers → prescriptions. Here, "diagnosis" means structural reinterpretation rather than medical diagnosis: vague complaints such as "I canʼt get started," "I canʼt keep going," or "I get exhausted immediately" are reorganized into symptom clusters that point to different intervention directions. 

This framework also repositions intervention literatures̶sleep, exercise, emotion regulation, habit formation, HCI, externalization, environmental design, organizational design, and productivity practices̶by asking which variables they affect. It further makes visible not only individual bottlenecks but also difficulties generated by organizations themselves through task design, meeting density, notification environments, evaluation structure, and access to support. The paper therefore shifts discussion away from willpower as a single resource and toward executability as a multivariable system, positioning GATE as a foundational theory for subsequent operational and implementation models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了目标对齐可执行性理论（GATE），将"动机"、"意志力"、"专注力"等日常概念重新概念化为一个多变量系统，用于解释目标对齐的非自动（受控）处理的启动、维持、分配、恢复等过程。该框架将常见的执行困难（如无法开始、无法持续、决策冻结等）视为不同的瓶颈结构，而非单一的意志力缺乏。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地理解和解释人类在执行目标导向任务时遇到的各种困难（如无法开始、无法持续、决策冻结等），并将这些现象重新概念化为一个可诊断和干预的多变量系统？
AI.motivation: 传统的"意志力"概念过于简化，无法解释执行困难的各种表现形式。人们常常将无法开始任务、无法持续工作、决策困难、疲劳后判断力下降等问题都归因于单一的"缺乏意志力"，但这种解释缺乏理论深度和实用指导价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 目标对齐可执行性理论（GATE）：将可执行性（目标对齐的非自动处理的启动、维持、分配、恢复和恢复的难易程度）概念化为一个多变量系统，包括特质变量、状态变量和情境变量。
AI.method: 理论构建和概念分析：通过重新概念化现有现象，构建一个包含激活阈值、并行处理能力、持续能力、处理效率、剩余能力、最大能力、恢复、背景消耗、任务复杂性、情绪噪音、习惯形成和外部化等变量的理论框架。
AI.findings: 提出了一个诊断-处方结构：症状→候选变量→干预杠杆→处方。将模糊的抱怨（如"我无法开始"、"我无法持续"、"我立即感到疲惫"）重新组织为指向不同干预方向的症状集群。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将意志力重新概念化为多变量可执行性系统；2. 提供结构化诊断框架；3. 整合睡眠、运动、情绪调节、习惯形成、人机交互、外部化、环境设计、组织设计等干预文献；4. 揭示组织层面产生的执行困难。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为个人提供具体的诊断和干预工具；2. 为组织设计提供指导（任务设计、会议密度、通知环境、评估结构、支持获取）；3. 为后续操作和实施模型奠定理论基础；4. 将讨论从道德化的"意志力"转向可操作的"可执行性"。

title:
Sovereign-Civilian Capacity Dynamics
A Formal Theory of State Power, Civilian Accumulation, and Imperial Decline

detail.title:
Sovereign-Civilian Capacity Dynamics
A Formal Theory of State Power, Civilian Accumulation, and Imperial Decline
detail.abstract: This paper introduces Sovereign-Civilian Capacity Dynamics (SCCD), a formal theoretical framework modeling the structural tension between the organized capacity of the state and the aggregate capacity of its civilian population. We define two primary state variables: S(t), the Sovereign Surplus Capacity, representing the portion of state power available for discretionary deployment beyond the minimum required to maintain social order; and C(t), the Aggregate Civilian Capacity, representing the distributed economic, political, and organizational power of the non-state population. The central quantity of interest is the differential Δ(t) = S(t)-C(t), which we demonstrate is the decisive determinant of a state's behavioral regimefrom imperial unilateralism through negotiated governance to institutional collapse. Part I establishes the theoretical motivation, positions the framework within the existing literature on state capacity, political economy, and historical sociology, and defines the conceptual architecture. We argue that prior frameworksincluding Tilly's coercion-capital theory, Olson's institutional sclerosis model, and Turchin's secular cycle theoryeach capture partial dynamics but lack a unified accounting of the bidirectional transfer between state and civilian capacity. SCCD provides this by treating both S and C as decomposable vector quantities whose interaction is governed by explicit drain, generation, and reconstitution dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了主权-平民能力动态（SCCD）理论框架，用于建模国家组织能力与平民集体能力之间的结构性张力，通过主权剩余能力S(t)和总平民能力C(t)的差值Δ(t)来解释国家行为模式从帝国单边主义到协商治理再到制度崩溃的转变。
AI.research_question: 国家主权能力与平民能力之间的动态关系如何决定国家行为模式的变化？
AI.motivation: 现有理论（如Tilly的强制-资本理论、Olson的制度僵化模型、Turchin的长期周期理论）各自捕捉了部分动态，但缺乏对国家和平民能力之间双向转移的统一解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权-平民能力动态（SCCD）理论框架，将主权剩余能力S(t)和总平民能力C(t)作为可分解的向量量，通过Δ(t)=S(t)-C(t)的差值决定国家行为模式。
AI.method: 形式化理论建模，建立概念架构，分析S和C之间的相互作用，包括消耗、生成和重构动态。
AI.findings: Δ(t)是决定国家行为模式的关键变量，从帝国单边主义（Δ>0）到协商治理（Δ≈0）再到制度崩溃（Δ<0）的转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提供了统一框架解释国家和平民能力之间的双向转移；2）将能力视为可分解的向量量；3）明确了消耗、生成和重构动态的相互作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估国家稳定性和治理模式的分析工具，有助于预测国家行为模式转变和制度崩溃风险。

title: Medical Device Defence -Closing the Vulnerability Gap in Hospital Environments

detail.title: Medical Device Defence -Closing the Vulnerability Gap in Hospital Environments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This paper reflects independent professional observations from the author's work in healthcare cybersecurity.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethics approval was required. This paper contains no patient data, clinical trials, or human subjects research. It is a policy and practice analysis based on professional experience and publicly available information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Medical device cybersecurity has no shortage of frameworks, standards, or regulatory guidance. What it lacks is something far simpler: working accountability for what happens to a vulnerable device after it is deployed in a clinical environment. This paper is written from four years of direct experience as an Infrastructure Lead in hospital systems. The core observation is straightforward-when a medical device cannot be patched, a patching exception gets filed and the device stays on the network. No segmentation. No compensating controls. No follow-up. The exception becomes permanent by default. When hospitals contact manufacturers about known vulnerabilities, the most common response is no response at all. These are not edge cases. They are the norm. This paper argues that the failure of medical device cybersecurity is fundamentally a governance failure-manufacturers, hospitals, and regulators each bear partial responsibility and none owns the problem fully. It proposes three concrete reforms: mandatory patch SLAs tied to market authorization, published endof-security-support dates at time of sale, and connected device inventory as a condition of CMS reimbursement. Each reform assigns accountability to a specific party with a specific consequence for failure. That is what the current system lacks.

AI.tldr: 医疗设备网络安全缺乏真正的问责机制，设备漏洞无法修复时，医院只能申请例外处理，制造商无响应，监管缺失。本文提出三项具体改革：强制补丁SLA、公布安全支持截止日期、联网设备清单作为医保报销条件。
AI.research_question: 为什么医疗设备网络安全在现有框架下仍然失败？如何建立有效的问责机制来解决医疗设备网络安全问题？
AI.motivation: 作者基于四年医院系统基础设施主管的直接经验，观察到医疗设备漏洞无法修复时，医院只能申请例外处理，制造商无响应，监管缺失，导致网络安全问题长期存在。这不是边缘案例，而是常态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理失败理论 - 制造商、医院和监管机构各自承担部分责任，但没有一方完全拥有问题所有权。问责机制缺失是核心问题。
AI.method: 基于作者四年医院系统基础设施主管的直接实践经验观察，结合行业现状分析，提出改革建议。
AI.findings: 医疗设备网络安全失败的根本原因是治理失败：制造商不响应漏洞报告，医院无法修补设备只能申请永久例外，监管机构缺乏有效问责机制。现有框架、标准和监管指导无法解决实际问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将医疗设备网络安全问题重新定义为治理失败问题，而非单纯的技术或标准问题。提出了问责机制缺失是核心问题的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三项具体改革方案：1) 强制补丁服务水平协议与市场授权挂钩；2) 销售时公布安全支持截止日期；3) 联网设备清单作为CMS医保报销条件。每项改革都明确了责任方和失败后果。

title: Statutory Incidence Matters: Evidence from a Policy Intervention in the German Housing Market
affiliations: Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) - Faculty of Business Administration (Munich School of Management), Catholic University of Eichstaett-Ingolstadt - Ingolstadt School of Management,  and

detail.title: Statutory Incidence Matters: Evidence from a Policy Intervention in the German Housing Market

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study a German policy intervention that shifted the statutory incidence of real estate agent commissions from buyers to sellers. Liability-side equivalence predicts no effect on economic incidence as sellers are expected to pass on the additional burden through higher prices. We use real estate listings and transactions and exploit object-level susceptibility to the intervention in a difference-in-differences analysis. Contrary to economic theory, prices do not increase and sellers bear the burden of the intervention. Consistent with a lack of pass-through, sellers reduce demand for brokerage, especially when brokers are expensive and offer little benefit. Taken together, our results suggest that the intervention was effective at relieving homebuyers.

AI.tldr: 德国房地产中介佣金从买方转嫁到卖方的政策干预研究：与经济学理论预测相反，卖方未能通过提高房价转嫁成本，实际承担了佣金负担，买方获得实际利益
AI.research_question: 当房地产中介佣金法定负担从买方转移到卖方时，经济负担是否会如经济学理论预测的那样通过房价上涨转嫁给买方？
AI.motivation: 检验经济学中的"责任方等价"理论在房地产市场的适用性，研究政策干预对市场参与者的实际影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 责任方等价理论（Liability-side equivalence）预测法定负担转移不会改变经济负担分配，因为卖方会通过提高价格转嫁成本
AI.method: 使用德国房地产挂牌和交易数据，采用双重差分法（difference-in-differences）分析，利用不同房产对政策干预的敏感性差异
AI.findings: 与经济学理论预测相反：1）房价没有上涨；2）卖方实际承担了佣金负担；3）卖方减少了对中介服务的需求，特别是当中介费用高且收益低时
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了责任方等价理论在房地产市场的适用性，揭示了法定负担转移可能确实改变经济负担分配，提供了房地产市场不完全竞争的证据
AI.practical_contributions: 政策干预有效减轻了购房者负担，为房地产市场监管政策设计提供了实证依据，表明佣金负担转移政策能够实现其预期目标

title: Forecasting Volatility of Currencies and Oil with Brown Firms: A Mixed-frequency Approach
affiliations: Sacred Heart University, Sacred Heart University - Jack Welch College of Business, Sacred Heart University and National Chengchi University (NCCU)

detail.title: Forecasting Volatility of Currencies and Oil with Brown Firms: A Mixed-frequency Approach
detail.abstract: Climate risk is unequal: it affects different countries and assets differently, with important impacts on currencies and energy markets. And financial markets embed forward-looking information about climate risk expectations (Schlenker and Taylor (2021); Downey et al. (2023); Hale (2024)). We examine whether firms' climate exposure helps forecast realized volatility of commodity currencies and oil futures. To capture information about climate risk that arises at multiple frequencies, we construct 'green' and 'brown' indices using a mixed data frequency state-space model. Our dataset combines intraday prices for commodity currencies (AUD, EUR, CAD, and NOK), oil futures (WTI and Brent), and high frequency equity data for green and brown firms. We use a heterogeneous autoregressive (HAR) framework and assess robustness with a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model. The brown index significantly enhances out-of-sample forecasts for currency volatility, outperforming green and benchmark models. Our brown index aggregates signals from several economic channels. In particular, beyond the influence of global risk premia and policy uncertainty, it captures broad risks encompassing commodity prices and energy supply.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业气候风险暴露是否有助于预测大宗商品货币和原油期货的实际波动率。通过构建"绿色"和"棕色"指数，发现棕色指数显著提升货币波动率的样本外预测能力，优于绿色指数和基准模型。
AI.research_question: 企业的气候风险暴露是否有助于预测大宗商品货币和原油期货的实际波动率？
AI.motivation: 气候风险对不同国家和资产的影响存在差异，对货币和能源市场有重要影响。金融市场包含前瞻性的气候风险预期信息，但如何利用企业层面的气候暴露信息来预测金融市场的波动性尚需研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 气候风险对金融市场的影响理论；2) 混合数据频率状态空间模型；3) 异质自回归(HAR)框架；4) 长短期记忆(LSTM)神经网络模型。
AI.method: 1) 使用混合数据频率状态空间模型构建"绿色"和"棕色"指数；2) 数据集包括大宗商品货币(AUD, EUR, CAD, NOK)的日内价格、原油期货(WTI, Brent)价格、绿色和棕色企业的高频股票数据；3) 采用HAR框架进行预测分析；4) 使用LSTM模型进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 棕色指数显著提升货币波动率的样本外预测能力，优于绿色指数和基准模型。棕色指数通过多个经济渠道聚合信号，不仅捕捉全球风险溢价和政策不确定性的影响，还涵盖大宗商品价格和能源供应等广泛风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 开发了基于企业气候暴露的金融市场预测新方法；2) 证明了气候风险信息在预测金融波动性中的价值；3) 区分了"绿色"和"棕色"指数在预测能力上的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为投资者和风险管理提供新的气候风险预测工具；2) 帮助政策制定者理解气候风险对金融市场的传导机制；3) 为金融机构的气候风险管理提供实证依据。

title: When Wind Blows Through the Backdoor: Revisiting IV Estimates of Household Elasticities under Real-Time Electricity Pricing During the Energy Crisis
affiliations: , University of Cologne and

detail.title: When Wind Blows Through the Backdoor: Revisiting IV Estimates of Household Elasticities under Real-Time Electricity Pricing During the Energy Crisis

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We estimate household electricity demand responses to hourly prices under real-time pricing using Finnish smart-meter data, contrasting results under the European energy crisis with those from previously relatively stable market conditions. Methodologically, we show that the standard wind-based IV approach, which instruments prices with day-ahead wind generation forecasts, can be biased in residential settings with electric heating, because local wind conditions directly shift electricity demand through heating-related channels. Controlling for hourly local wind speeds provides a simple correction that preserves a strong first stage and reduces IV price coefficients by about 70 percent before the crisis and about 40 percent during the crisis. Yet, elasticities remain significant at -0.020 and -0.041, respectively. The direct wind effect on demand is economically meaningful: a 1 m/s increase in local wind speed raises hourly consumption by about 1 percent, comparable to the demand response induced by a 25–30 €/MWh price increase. Translating the elasticities into bill impacts yields mean annual per-household savings from short-run demand response of about €15.57 before the crisis and about €104.27 during the crisis, indicating moderate savings relative to total annual electricity expenditures.

AI.tldr: 使用芬兰智能电表数据研究家庭电力需求对实时电价的响应，对比能源危机前后结果。发现标准风电工具变量方法在有电加热的住宅中存在偏差，通过控制本地风速进行修正后，弹性系数仍显著为负。
AI.research_question: 家庭电力需求对实时电价的弹性如何？欧洲能源危机前后有何变化？标准风电工具变量方法在住宅环境中是否存在偏差？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭电力需求对实时电价的响应对于电力市场设计和需求侧管理至关重要。欧洲能源危机导致电价大幅波动，为研究需求弹性提供了独特机会。同时，现有风电工具变量方法在住宅环境中的有效性需要验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 电力需求弹性理论，实时定价对消费者行为的影响，工具变量方法在因果推断中的应用，能源危机对消费者响应的影响。
AI.method: 使用芬兰智能电表数据，采用工具变量方法，以日前风电预测作为价格工具变量，但发现该方法在有电加热的住宅中存在偏差，通过控制每小时本地风速进行修正。
AI.findings: 1) 标准风电工具变量方法在有电加热的住宅中存在偏差；2) 控制本地风速后，弹性系数仍显著为负：危机前-0.020，危机期间-0.041；3) 本地风速对需求有直接影响：风速增加1 m/s使每小时消费增加约1%；4) 需求响应带来的年均节省：危机前€15.57，危机期间€104.27。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 识别了标准风电工具变量方法在住宅环境中的偏差问题；2) 提出了通过控制本地风速的简单修正方法；3) 量化了能源危机前后需求弹性的变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为电力市场设计提供实证依据；2) 帮助政策制定者评估需求响应项目的效果；3) 为消费者提供需求响应潜在节省的参考；4) 为智能电表数据分析提供方法指导。

title: AI-Assisted Academic Writing as an Inquisitorial Appellate Court

detail.title: AI-Assisted Academic Writing as an Inquisitorial Appellate Court
detail.abstract: The rapid proliferation of generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude has ignited a fierce debate in academia over the legitimacy of AI-assisted writing. Critics equate its use with cheating, citing risks of hallucinations, plagiarism, and erosion of scholarly standards. Proponents counter that AI can enhance productivity and free researchers to focus on substantive intellectual contributions. This paper argues that AI-assisted academic writing, when practiced responsibly and under proper constraints, is not only defensible but, under the right institutional constraints, can enhance the efficiency of scholarly production without compromising its quality.
